title: Director, Head of Immerse India
description:
**Overview**
Waters Corporation is establishing Immerse India, a new innovation lab in Genome Valley, Hyderabad—one of India’s most important life sciences ecosystems. As the Director, you will build a nationally visible center that connects Waters with India’s scientific talent, pharma and biopharma industry, academic institutions, and entrepreneurial community. This is an opportunity to shape the lab from the ground up and strengthen India’s role in Waters’ global innovation network.
  
  
Immerse India is designed to serve as a convergence point for customers and collaborators to be surrounded by the latest technologies. It will enable external research partnerships, development collaborations, customer engagement, scientific seminars and hands-on demonstrations, focused on biosimilars, small molecule generics, and advanced materials characterization. Working closely with leadership across the four global Waters Divisions, Global Research, India commercial teams, and other local sponsors, the Director will convert regional customer needs into differentiated scientific solutions, research programs, and measurable growth opportunities.
  
  
This is a highly visible leadership role with a direct reporting line within Global Research and connection to Waters’ growing global network of Immerse labs. The Director will oversee a multi-disciplinary team of scientists and operational staff and will be a key architect of Waters' long-term growth strategy in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Site Leadership & Strategy**
Lead the overall strategy, operations, and scientific direction of Immerse India, ensuring alignment with Waters' global innovation priorities and India-specific market needs.
  
  
Collaborate on the build-out of an :1000 sq meters laboratory and collaboration space
  
  
Assist in recruiting, onboarding, and developing the full Immerse India team – including directs reports within Global Research as well as hosted scientists from Waters Divisions
  
  
Establish and manage a high-functioning, safety-compliant laboratory environment optimized for both research collaboration and customer demonstration activities.
  
  
Report progress, performance metrics, and strategic recommendations to the SVP of Research and Strategy.
  
  
**External Collaboration & Customer Engagement**
Develop and manage a robust portfolio of collaborations with India's leading pharma and biopharma companies as well as premier academic and research institutions.
  
  
Drive high-value research partnerships focused on biosimilar characterization, small molecule generics, GLP-1 workflows, multi-omics, and advanced materials characterization.
  
  
Translate customer scientific challenges into innovative analytical and materials science solutions using Waters' full portfolio of instrumentation.
  
  
Represent Waters as a scientific thought leader at regional symposia, industry conferences, and customer events hosted at the Immerse India facility.
  
  
**Scientific & Commercial Impact**
Oversee research and collaboration programs targeting biosimilar characterization (LNPs, viral vectors, conjugates) and small molecule/generic drug workflows (nitrosamines, impurities, PK/PD studies).
  
  
Support material science programs in thermal analysis and rheology applications for pharmaceutical formulations and advanced materials.
  
  
Build a measurable pipeline of customer engagements and collaboration-led opportunities by partnering with Indian commercial leaders, applications teams, and divisional sponsors. Track instrument utilization, customer progression, influenced pipeline, adoption outcomes, and revenue impact while protecting the scientific integrity and long-term value of the lab’s research portfolio.
  
  
Co-develop and lead research programs with Global Research scientists, connecting Indian customer insight, samples, scientific expertise, and external collaborators with Waters’ global technology and innovation priorities. Ensure locally generated knowledge is shared across the global organization and translated into research, development, application, and commercial decisions.
  
  
Enable publication of high-impact scientific work co-authored with external collaborators to build Waters' scientific credibility in the region.
  
  
**Team Development & Operations**
Recruit, mentor, and develop a growing multidisciplinary team of scientists and operational colleagues, creating a culture of scientific rigor, safety, inclusion, customer partnership, and continuous learning. Initial size anticipated to be 6+ Global Research FTE direct reports and 3+ dotted-line reporting FTEs from Divisions.
  
  
Manage day-to-day site operations in coordination with the Lab Manager, ensuring instrument readiness, consumables availability, safety compliance, and event execution.
  
  
Partner with the local divisional sponsors to coordinate application support and collaboration priorities.
  
  
Work with the Event Coordinator to manage the lab calendar, host high-value customer visits, and support Waters' commercial and marketing initiatives in India.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication & Visibility**
Serve as the primary internal and external spokesperson for Immerse India, communicating the lab's value, impact, and scientific vision to Waters leadership, business divisions, and external partners.
  
  
Collaborate with Global Research Leadership, divisional commercial teams, and the Communications team to amplify Immerse India's story internally and in the market.
  
  
Connect with other Immerse Labs to establish a global innovation network working to solve grand challenge problems
  
  
Provide regular updates to executive sponsors and stakeholders on scientific milestones, collaboration health, customer engagement, talent development, operational performance, commercial pipeline influence, and progress against the lab’s strategic objectives.
  
  
**Required**
**Qualifications**
Advanced degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, biochemistry, materials science, or a closely related scientific or engineering discipline. A PhD is preferred; candidates with a master’s degree and substantial scientific, technical, and leadership experience will also be considered.
  
  
10+ years of progressive experience in life sciences tools, analytical instrumentation, pharmaceutical R&D, biopharma, or a related field, including demonstrated leadership of scientific teams.
  
  
Deep scientific expertise in at least one of the following domains: chromatography and mass spectrometry (HPLC/UPLC, LC-MS), biosimilar/biologic characterization, small molecule pharmaceutical analysis, or thermal/rheological analysis.
  
  
Proven track record of building and managing external research collaborations with pharma, biopharma, or academic institutions.
  
  
Strong commercial acumen demonstrated by converting scientific or customer insight into qualified opportunities, strategic accounts, application adoption, portfolio decisions, or revenue growth. Able to build investment cases, make portfolio trade-offs, manage budgets, and communicate value and risk to senior leadership.
  
  
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with experience influencing senior management and engaging external scientific communities.
  
  
Strong knowledge of India’s pharma, biopharma, analytical sciences, and academic ecosystem, with the credibility and relationship-building ability to establish a network across customers, key opinion leaders, research institutions, industry associations, start-ups, CROs, and CDMOs.
  
  
Experience operating responsibly within India’s scientific and business environment, including awareness of relevant laboratory, environmental, employment, import, data, intellectual property, and industry compliance considerations. Able to work effectively with local functions and external advisers while applying Waters’ global standards.
  
  
**Preferred**
MBA or equivalent business training is a plus.
  
  
Experience in a multi-national company managing cross-functional stakeholders across geographies.
  
  
Familiarity with Waters instrumentation or competing analytical technologies.
  
  
Prior experience standing up a new lab, center of excellence, or innovation hub.
  
  
Publications record in peer-reviewed journals relevant to analytical sciences or materials characterization.
  
  
**Company Description**
Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of :16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.
  
  
Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Manager III Operations, Quick Commerce Central Flow, NOC, NOC - Central Flow Quick Commerce
description:
**Description**
 Over the past 20\+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy, Amazon is now redefining speed through Quick Commerce — delivering to customers in minutes, not days.
   

  

 APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra\-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle\-free, on\-time flow of inventory across all hops — from hubs to Micro\-Fulfillment Centers (MFCs) and onward to the customer. In case of any exceptions, the NOC steps in to resolve the issue in real time and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem\-solving, the NOC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations — work that involves live network monitoring and significant analysis of high\-velocity delivery data.
   

  

 Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra\-fast delivery promise, and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Role**
 This role sits at the heart of Central Flow for Quick Commerce, owning end\-to\-end network flow health across all hops — from hubs into MFCs and every flow in between. As the network's flow steward, the incumbent will:
   

  

 Identify egregious metrics in real time — spotting flow disruptors, bottlenecks, and exceptions before they cascade.
   

  

 Coordinate actions across teams — mobilizing operations, tech, program, and field teams to keep the network in flow when disruptions hit.
   

  

 Build learnings for next time — codifying every intervention into playbooks and reusable recovery frameworks so the network responds faster with each recurrence.
   

  

 Track until normal state — owning each disruption from detection through recovery, confirming stabilization before closing the loop.
   

  

 Leadership Scope: The incumbent will lead a team of L2s, L3s, and managers. As Quick Commerce scales, this role will continuously evolve to take on new workstreams — the successful candidate must be energized by ambiguity and comfortable building the plane while flying it.
   

  

 What We're Looking For: An experienced, hands\-on Manager passionate about using data to drive efficiencies and influence decisions. Deep functional knowledge, program\-design ability, and defect\-reduction experience required. Strong analytical skills and Excel expertise essential; SQL and R/Python a plus. Superb communication, project management, and stakeholder skills, with adeptness in AI tools (Kiro, Amazon Quick).
   

  

**About The Team**
 Over the past 20\+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy of innovation, Amazon is now redefining speed itself through Quick Commerce — delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes, not days.
   

  

 APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra\-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle\-free, on\-time flow of inventory from dark stores, micro\-fulfillment centers (MFCs), and neighborhood hubs to the customer's doorstep within the promised delivery window (typically 10–30 minutes). In case of any exceptions — a delayed rider, an out\-of\-stock item, a demand surge, or a hyperlocal supply gap — the NOC steps in in real time to resolve the issue and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings.
   

  

 Along with this tactical, real\-time problem solving, the NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions across dense delivery zones and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations. This second aspect involves live network monitoring, demand forecasting, and significant analysis of high\-velocity delivery data.
   

  

 Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra\-fast delivery promise and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 3\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience establishing processes, workflows, standard procedures and change management

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed. * Fails investigation \- Checking the cash non\-receipt reports and the custody settlement system (MCH) and initiating correspondence with the client
* Reporting \- Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal reporting from an access database and Protocol.
* Portfolio reconciliations \- Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing \- Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Cyber Review Manager
 



**Job Families for Job Profiles:** 
 Cyber Review
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad Remote
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The Cyber Review Manager is responsible for leading cyber incident response review operations and managing teams that support data breach, privacy, and cyber incident review engagements. This role ensures the accurate identification, review, and protection of sensitive information while maintaining compliance with regulatory, contractual, and client requirements.
 



 The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in cyber incident response, data breach review, and eDiscovery review platforms such as Relativity and Canopy. This individual will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, drive quality and operational excellence, oversee review workflows, mentor analysts, and support the successful delivery of cyber review projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Cyber Incident Response \& Review Management** 



* Manage end\-to\-end cyber incident review and data breach response projects, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Oversee the identification, review, validation, and extraction of personally identifiable information (PII), protected health information (PHI), and other sensitive data exposed during cyber incidents.
* Conduct quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established review protocols.
* Collaborate with Incident Response, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Security teams to support cyber incident investigations.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and internal governance standards.



**Operational Excellence \& Risk Management** 



* Monitor project metrics, identify trends, and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
* Conduct vulnerability and risk assessments related to cyber review workflows and data handling practices.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action planning for review\-related issues.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve review procedures, quality standards, and documentation guidelines.
* Assist with internal audits, client audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting activities.



**Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and coach Cyber Review Analysts and Senior Analysts.
* Conduct performance discussions, provide constructive feedback, and support career development initiatives.
* Facilitate onboarding, cross\-training, and continuous learning programs for review teams.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture focused on accountability, quality, and client service.



**Technology \& Reporting** 



* Leverage Relativity, Canopy, and other review technologies to manage review workflows and reporting.
* Utilize advanced Excel, SQL, and reporting tools to analyze review data, identify trends, and support operational decision\-making.
* Support the implementation and optimization of AI\-assisted review and analytics processes.
* Prepare dashboards and reports highlighting project performance, quality metrics, risks, and resource utilization.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB/LLM), Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Cyber Incident Response or Data Breach.
* Minimum 3 years of people management experience leading review teams or operational teams.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience with Relativity and Canopy platforms.
* Experience managing client\-facing projects within a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience handling sensitive and confidential information in compliance with privacy and security regulations.
* Experience within legal technology, eDiscovery, privacy review, or cyber incident response service industries.
* Documentation \& Compliance Management
* Professional certification like CIPP, CISSP, CISM Preferred
* Security\+ or equivalent cybersecurity certification Preferred
* Relativity Certified Administrator (RCA) or Relativity certification Preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* Ability to work flexible schedules when required to support critical cyber incident response engagements.
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

title: Drone Operations Lead
company: Saurava Drones AI and Logistics Private Limited
description:
Job Purpose
 
 The Drone Operations Lead will be responsible for planning, managing, and executing end\-to\-end drone operations across projects. The role will lead drone pilots and field teams, ensure safe and compliant flight operations, maintain operational readiness of the drone fleet, coordinate project execution, and ensure timely delivery of operational targets.
 


 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
 
 1\. Drone Operations Management
 


* Lead and manage day\-to\-day drone operations across multiple projects and locations.
* Plan flight operations based on project requirements, timelines, manpower, and equipment availability.
* Ensure efficient utilization of drones, pilots, technicians, and other operational resources.
* Monitor field operations and ensure projects are executed as per defined SOPs.



 2\. Pilot \& Field Team Management
 


* Manage, allocate, and supervise Drone Pilots, Technicians, and Field Executives.
* Prepare pilot deployment and operational rosters based on project requirements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide operational guidance to the team.
* Identify training and certification requirements for pilots and field personnel.



 3\. Flight Safety \& Compliance
 


* Ensure all drone operations comply with applicable DGCA regulations, company policies, and project\-specific requirements.
* Ensure pilots possess valid and relevant certifications/authorizations wherever required.
* Conduct pre\-flight and post\-flight safety checks.
* Ensure adherence to approved flight plans, operational SOPs, airspace restrictions, and safety protocols.
* Maintain records of flight operations, incidents, near misses, and corrective actions.



 4\. Drone Fleet \& Equipment Management
 


* Ensure operational readiness of drones, payloads, batteries, controllers, and accessories.
* Coordinate with the technical/maintenance team for preventive maintenance and repairs.
* Maintain records of drone utilization, battery cycles, maintenance, damage, and downtime.
* Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and inventory of drone equipment.



 5\. Project Execution
 


* Coordinate with project managers and clients to understand operational requirements and deliverables.
* Develop operational plans, deployment schedules, and resource requirements for projects.
* Ensure field teams achieve project targets within agreed timelines.
* Resolve operational issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely escalation and closure.



 6\. Data \& Reporting
 


* Ensure accurate collection, validation, and submission of drone operation data.
* Review flight logs, mission reports, imagery/data outputs, and operational records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Track key operational metrics including flight hours, missions completed, pilot productivity, drone utilization, downtime, incidents, and project completion.



 7\. Quality Control
 


* Ensure drone missions are conducted according to defined quality standards.
* Review operational outputs and identify errors, gaps, or deviations.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve operational quality.
* Work with the technical/data teams to resolve issues affecting project deliverables.



 8\. Training \& SOP Development
 


* Develop and continuously improve operational SOPs, checklists, and safety procedures.
* Conduct induction and operational training for new pilots and field staff.
* Organize refresher training and practical assessments for existing pilots.
* Promote a strong safety and compliance culture across the operations team.



 9\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
 


* Coordinate with drone manufacturers, service providers, repair vendors, training institutes, and other external partners.
* Support procurement decisions for drones, payloads, batteries, and operational equipment.
* Coordinate with government authorities and other stakeholders wherever required for project execution.



 10\. Cost \& Resource Optimization
 


* Monitor operational expenses and ensure efficient utilization of resources.
* Optimize pilot deployment, travel, equipment usage, and field logistics.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operational downtime and improve productivity.



  




 Ideal Candidate Profile
 * 5–8 years of experience in drone/UAV operations, aviation, field operations, or a similar environment.
* Strong understanding of drone operations, flight planning, safety procedures, and field deployment.
* Experience managing drone pilots and field teams.
* Knowledge of DGCA drone regulations and operational compliance.
* Strong troubleshooting and decision\-making skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.
* Strong reporting, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Drone Pilot certification/experience.



  





 Candidates interested to apply, please drop your resume to hr@sauravadrones.com.

description:
**Description**
 Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
   

  

 Over the past 20\+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
   

  

 Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Responsibilities of Manager I under Relay Ops/NOC
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and program teams. We're looking for a hands\-on and motivated self\-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision\-making.
   

  

 A Manager I is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.
   

  

 The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer\-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project\-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy\-to\-understand way.
   

  

 What are we really looking for?
   

  

* You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data
* You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
* You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks
* You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
* You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
* You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
* You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
* You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance
* You should be willing to work in rotational shifts
* Languages proficiency (mandatory) – English.


**The Manager I Is Required To**
* Cost Reduction Strategy:
* Develop and implement strategies to reduce costs in the transportation business


 (ii) Analyze and optimize adhoc share, number of trips, and truck utilization
   

  

 (iii) Participate in and contribute to WBR meetings with the core group
   

  

* Network Optimization:
* Work on improving network design
* Optimize NOC Governance Mechanism
* Improve RLB adoption and truck utilization
* Forecasting and Scheduling:
* Enhance and expand Forecast Based Scheduling (FBS) feature
* Analyze and act on Frequent Adhoc \& Frequent Cancellation (FAFC) trends
* Optimize schedule capacity and reduce adhoc share
* Cost per Trip Reduction:
* Address issues leading to increased cost per trip collaborate with all the miles to reduce unloading delays
* Improve RLB conversion rates and manage manual adhoc rates
* Truck Utilization Improvement:
* Continue efforts to increase average totes per trip
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve fill rates
* Process Standardization and Improvement:
* Standardize stacking height for palletized loading
* Develop and implement SOPs for improved asset handling and transfer
* Cross\-functional Collaboration:
* Work closely with FC, SC, EWH, and other teams to implement improvements
* Coordinate with tech teams for necessary system enhancements
* Manage stakeholder relationships and secure buy\-in for new initiatives
* Data Analysis and Reporting:
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses for proposed initiatives
* Create and maintain performance dashboards
* Provide regular updates on KPIs and project progress
* Continuous Improvement:
* Identify new opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement
* Plan and execute pilot projects to test new ideas
* Scale successful initiatives across the network


 This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical skills, project management expertise, and strong cross\-functional leadership to drive significant improvements in the linehaul network's efficiency and cost\-effectiveness.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The incumbent will own the following \-
   

  

* They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
* They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no\-go decisions on various initiatives
* Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
* The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
* They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.

 NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. title: Hotel Manager
description:
**Hotel Manager** 




**Loop by Zolo** 




**Own the property. Build the team. Create a stay people want to experience again.** 




  





**Offered CTC: 7 LPA \- 9 LPA** 




  





**Why this role exists** 




 Loop by Zolo is building a new\-age hostel experience for young travellers — bringing together comfortable stays, social experiences, community, and dependable hospitality.
 



 In a hostel, guests don't experience the property only through their room or bed.
 



 They experience it through the energy of the property, the people they meet, the cleanliness of shared spaces, the responsiveness of the team, the food and social spaces, and the experiences created during their stay.
 



 As Loop scales, the challenge is not simply running hostels — it is ensuring that every property delivers the same combination of
 **strong operations, vibrant guest experience, community, and business performance.** 




 This role exists to ensure that each Loop property operates as a well\-controlled, high\-performing business unit while still feeling social, welcoming, and alive.
 



 If the General Manager / Hostel Manager is strong, the property runs smoothly, guests engage, teams perform, and the business delivers.
 



 If the General Manager / Hostel Manager is weak, service becomes inconsistent, the property loses energy, costs leak, reviews decline, and the guest experience suffers.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own the Loop property end\-to\-end as a business unit
* Deliver a consistently clean, safe, social, and high\-quality guest experience
* Create an environment where guests want to interact, participate, and return
* Build and lead a strong, accountable property team
* Enforce operational discipline without making the property experience rigid
* Handle escalations and high\-pressure situations with control
* Drive occupancy, revenue, control costs, and protect profitability



 This is not a property supervision role.
 **It is full ownership of the property, the guest experience, the community, and its business outcomes.** 




  





**About Zolo and Loop by Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



**Loop by Zolo brings together affordable stays, social experiences, and community\-led travel for a new generation of travellers.** 




 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — creating spaces where people can live, stay, travel, and connect.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\. Own Business Performance \& Outcomes** 



* Take full ownership of revenue, occupancy, cost, and profitability
* Track daily property performance and take corrective actions
* Understand bed inventory, occupancy patterns, pricing, and demand
* Identify revenue opportunities and eliminate cost leakages
* Drive property\-level performance reviews and accountability
* Balance guest experience, occupancy, and financial outcomes



**2\. Deliver a Consistent Guest Experience** 



* Own the complete guest journey from arrival to departure
* Ensure rooms, dorms, washrooms, common areas, and social spaces are consistently clean and well maintained
* Drive consistency across front office, housekeeping, F\&B, and other guest\-facing functions
* Monitor guest feedback and online reviews and act quickly on recurring issues
* Identify the moments that create guest delight or dissatisfaction
* Ensure guests feel welcomed, comfortable, and supported throughout their stay



**3\. Build Community \& Social Experience** 



* Ensure the property feels active, welcoming, and social rather than simply being a place to sleep
* Create an environment that encourages guest interaction and participation
* Drive property\-level activities, events, and experiences relevant to Loop guests
* Ensure common and social spaces are actively used and well managed
* Work with the team to understand guest interests and continuously improve experiences
* Balance community energy with guest comfort, safety, and property discipline



**4\. Build \& Lead a High\-Performing Team** 



* Hire, train, and upgrade team members across property functions
* Build a strong second line across Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, and other key areas
* Set clear expectations and enforce accountability
* Coach teams on guest interaction, service standards, communication, and professionalism
* Build a team that understands the difference between transactional service and genuine hospitality
* Identify and act on underperformance early



**5\. Drive Execution Excellence \& Process Discipline** 



* Ensure SOP adherence across all operational areas
* Maintain consistency across shifts and teams
* Identify operational gaps and fix them quickly
* Ensure strong coordination between Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Maintenance, and other teams
* Maintain high standards of hygiene, safety, grooming, and presentation
* Ensure processes support the guest experience rather than create unnecessary friction



**6\. Handle Escalations \& High\-Pressure Situations** 



* Take immediate ownership of guest and operational escalations
* Manage peak occupancy and high\-pressure periods with structured decision\-making
* Resolve issues with speed, clarity, and confidence
* Handle situations involving shared spaces and different guest expectations sensitively
* Coordinate across teams to ensure quick resolution
* Conduct post\-incident reviews and prevent recurrence



**7\. Drive Revenue, Occupancy \& Commercial Discipline** 



* Monitor occupancy, pricing, demand patterns, and booking trends
* Identify opportunities to improve bed utilisation and property revenue
* Drive upselling, walk\-ins, group bookings, F\&B, experiences, and other property\-level revenue opportunities
* Control unnecessary discounting and prevent revenue leakage
* Align with central Sales, Revenue, Marketing, and OTA teams
* Understand the relationship between guest ratings, experiences, demand, occupancy, and revenue



**8\. Maintain Reporting \& System Discipline** 



* Ensure accuracy and real\-time updates across PMS and property systems
* Maintain clean and reliable daily reporting
* Track occupancy, revenue, guest experience, cost, and operational metrics
* Flag risks and performance gaps early
* Review discrepancies and ensure data reliability
* Use data to make decisions rather than relying only on instinct



**What success looks like after 12 months** 



* Property consistently delivers a clean, safe, smooth, and memorable guest experience
* Guests experience Loop as a social and welcoming place, not simply accommodation
* Strong and stable team with clear ownership across functions
* High and improving guest ratings driven by service and experience quality
* Strong participation in property experiences and social activities
* Minimal recurring operational errors and escalations
* Strong control over occupancy, revenue, costs, and profitability
* Healthy utilisation of beds and property spaces
* Reliable, accurate, and timely reporting
* Property performance does not depend on the General Manager personally solving every problem



**The property feels structured behind the scenes, but energetic, social, and effortless to the guest.** 




  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You take ownership of the entire property, not just Operations
* You think in terms of business performance, not just service delivery
* You understand that a hostel experience is as much about people and community as it is about rooms
* You are comfortable leading teams and holding people accountable
* You can create energy while maintaining operational discipline
* You stay calm and structured in high\-pressure situations
* You notice gaps in execution and fix them quickly
* You enjoy interacting with guests and staying close to what is happening on the property
* You believe consistency comes from strong teams and systems, not individual firefighting



  





**Experience we value** 



* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in hospitality, hostel, hotel, travel, or customer\-facing operations
* Prior experience managing a property, business unit, or significant hospitality operation
* Experience managing teams across multiple operational functions
* Strong exposure to guest experience and escalation handling
* Experience working in SOP\-driven, shift\-based operating environments
* Exposure to occupancy, revenue, cost, and property\-level business metrics
* Ability to manage both people and business performance



 Experience in
 **Hostels, Hotels, Backpacker Accommodation, Resorts, Managed Hospitality, Co\-living, or other experience\-led hospitality businesses** 
 will be valuable.
 



**Ownership mindset, business orientation, leadership ability, guest obsession, and execution discipline are critical.** 




  





**The impact you will have** 




 You will define how guests experience Loop from the moment they enter the property until they leave.
 



 You will determine whether the property simply provides accommodation or creates an experience guests remember and recommend.
 



 You will build a team capable of delivering consistently without depending on constant supervision.
 



 You will directly influence
 **guest ratings, community experience, repeat stays, occupancy, revenue, and profitability.** 




  





**Why join now** 




 Loop by Zolo is building its presence in the hostel and experience\-led travel space.
 



 As the portfolio expands, the strength of each property will depend on leaders who can combine:
 



**Great Hospitality** 




**Strong Community** 




**Operational Discipline** 




**Commercial Performance** 




**High\-Energy Teams** 




 This role gives you the opportunity to own the complete property rather than one function within it.
 



**If you believe the best hostels are not simply operated well, but create an experience people want to come back to — this is the opportunity to build exactly that.**

title: Security Manager - Data Centre Operations
description:
**Job title**
 : Security Manager \- Data Centre Operations
 ***(Internally called Site Security Manager)***




**Reports to**
 : Campus Security Manager, Hyderabad
 



**Location**
 : Hyderabad, India
 



  





**About our team**




 We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30\+ countries. Our client is an industry\-leading datacenter organization, and we pride ourselves on delivering best\-in\-class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Business Operations, Shared Services, Threat and Incident Management, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you’ll be part of
 



 our leadership team and work alongside a group of professionals that are committed to excellence and innovation.
 



  





**About the role**




 The Site Security Manager (SSM) serves as the day\-to\-day manager of a 24/7 datacenter physical security operations team, supporting a client’s datacenter or other critical facility. Reporting to a Campus Security Manager (CSM), the SSM builds a cohesive, high\-performing team that delivers a safe, secure, and compliant environment while meeting client expectations.
 



  





 The SSM also collaborates with other campus security leaders to maintain consistent security standards across the campus. Additional responsibilities may include client service and issue resolution, service enhancements, Security Operations Center (SOC) systems maintenance, audit compliance, system monitoring, log and documentation maintenance, and access rights administration. Based on coverage needs, the SSM may be required to support and provide leadership coverage at other assigned sites within the campus/region in addition to their primary site.
 



  





**What you’ll do**




 In this role, the Site Security Manager (SSM) leads the on‑site security team and oversees day‑to‑day security operations within a 24/7 environment. You are responsible for directly managing security personnel, including administrative officers, responders, control room staff, and other security team members, while ensuring consistent staffing coverage and operational continuity.
 



  





 You partner with local leadership to support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, and employee development. This includes coaching and mentoring team members, setting expectations, and managing performance and corrective actions in line with company policy. You also work closely with client leadership across multiple business groups to support site operations.
 



  





 Operationally, you ensure compliance with security policies, procedures, and standard operating guidelines. You monitor site performance and key metrics, identify risks or security gaps, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement. You maintain required documentation, logs, and reports, oversee on‑site security systems such as access control, CCTV, and incident management tools, and support audits, inspections, and other compliance activities.
 



  





 The role requires clear, professional communication with clients and internal partners, including leading meetings and presentations. You escalate significant events and risks as needed, promote safe work practices, handle sensitive information with discretion and support additional operational needs as they arise.
 



  





**What you need to apply**




 To apply for this role, you should have an associate degree and 6\+ years of relevant experience in the security industry, including 3\+ years of managing people. Experience leading teams in a security and/or datacenter environment is strongly preferred. You should also have hands‑on experience with security technologies such as CCTV, access control systems, incident management tools, and video surveillance platforms. Strong, practical proficiency with Microsoft Office is
 



 expected, as reporting, documentation, and operational tracking are essential parts of the role.
 



  





 This position is best suited for a proven people leader who is comfortable balancing operational leadership, administrative accountability, and client‑facing responsibilities within a 24/7 security environment.
 



  





 All applicants must have reliable means of communication and transportation (public or private) to travel to and from work, the legal right to work in the country where the position is located, and proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing in English and
 **a common local language (where applicable).**




  





 Applicants must also be able and willing to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (such as during emergencies or high‑priority events). Applicants must be able to meet and continue to meet licensing requirements for security officers, as applicable to local, county, and state laws and regulations.
 



  





**What you’ll get**




 We offer more than just a job; we offer the chance to be part of a collaborative and supportive team where your contributions are valued and your growth matters. In this role, you will thrive in a dynamic environment while supporting a prestigious multinational client account. You will gain exposure to global operations and cross\-regional collaboration, and you will have access to continuous learning, training programs, and career development opportunities designed to help
 



 you succeed.
 



  





**The extra stuff**




 Candidates must be at least 18 years old, legally authorized to work in the job location, and willing to complete the company’s pre‑employment screening, including a background check and drug screening. This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high‑priority events. Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness.
 



  





 The role involves performing essential duties with or without reasonable accommodation, which may include periods of sitting, standing, and walking throughout the shift (including walking distances of up to approximately 12 miles / 19 km), climbing stairs, and occasionally lifting or moving items weighing up to 25 pounds (11 kg)

title: Procurement Execution Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

 Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO\&I) is the team behind the cloud.  Within CO\&I, the Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi\-disciplinary, large scale, multi\-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate and motivated professional to help build cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.  In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Data Center “Campus LLE Procurement Execution Manager” is a site\-based role accountable for post\-award execution of LLE (Long Lead Equipment) and OFCI (Owner Furnished Contractor Installed) packages across assigned data\-centre projects. The role leads Delivery, Site readiness, Supplier Mobilisation, Equipment Commissioning support, Risk management and Commercial governance from Equipment PO (Purchase\-order) handover to DC Operations handover. Working across Strategic Sourcing, Project controls, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Quality and Cost teams, the role drives Safe, Timely, Compliant and Commercially controlled outcomes
   

  

 Success in the role requires strong procurement, project execution, supplier management, negotiation, and stakeholder leadership capabilities, together with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, matrixed project environment. The overall objective is to deliver OFCI equipment safely, on time, to the required quality standard and within approved commercial and governance controls.
   

  

 Compliance
   

  

* Act as the compliance gate for post\-award OFCI changes, by monitoring change orders and Provisional Change Order service levels, preventing After\-the\-Fact commitments, and escalate urgent cases with validated evidence, project impact and a recommended compliant path forward.
* Own OFCI payment\-compliance controls by verifying that each supplier's Payment Application is supported by contractual entitlement, maintain an auditable record of the assessment, and ensure payment claims align with approved cash\-flow forecasts.
* Identify emerging risks through data\-driven approach and drive action to protect current project delivery schedule
* Leads decision making around the execution and evolution of various workstream processes, identifies and seeks solutions to compliance gaps, and influences leadership to drive change internally and/or externally.
* Ensures adherence to procurement policy, educates stakeholders and suppliers on policy compliance, and drives the remediation and resolution of any issues.


**Responsibilities**
 DC Campus LLE Procurement Execution Manager
   

  

**On Time Delivery**
* Own the integrated post\-award OFCI delivery plan for his/her Campus Data Center Projects from purchase\-order handover through manufacturing at OEMs, Factory acceptance testing, logistics, site delivery, installation interfaces, commissioning support and final handover to operations team.
* Maintain alignment between contractual delivery dates, supplier schedules, site\-readiness milestones and the overall project program
* Ensure On time delivery as per OEMs Contractual ROJs (Required on Job Site) dates
* Help facilitate the LLE/OFCI (Owner Furnish Contractor Installed) equipment once delivered to site, including inspections and appropriate sign offs.
* Address quality\-related issues as they arise and report to the quality team and category management as appropriate for speedy resolution


**Supplier Engagement \& Performance Management**
* Qualification of OEMs local facilites to increase Localization \& Skidding/pre\-Fabrication
* Manage post\-award supplier performance across manufacturing stage, delivery, field\-service support, quality and commercial obligations.
* Establish regular governance cadence, maintain measurable performance indicators and drive recovery or corrective action plans, when performance falls below Contractual or Project requirements.
* Communicate scheduling delays from OFCI equipment suppliers to relevant stakeholders \& develop mitigation strategies.
* Oversee site specific procurement activities and collaborate with both internal and external partners to proactively resolve issues.


**Field Service Technician/Engineer Management (OEM)**
* Align OEMs FSR (Field Service Resources) plan in coordination with the General Contractor, DCD \& Commissioning team requirement to support Overall Project/Commissioning schedule
* Actively engage, negotiate and manage OEMs FSRs, to accommodate project schedule compression and acceleration as needed.


**Change Order Management**
* Initiate and govern post\-award change orders from identification and entitlement review through Scope validation, quotation assessment, approval, purchase\-order amendment, execution and commercial closure.
* Monitor and mitigate the impact of change orders to the project schedule, and partners cross\-functionally to resolve/escalate issues if any
* Attend cost/change management meetings to ensure any change orders of additional equipment are executed promptly and timely.
* Act as a subject matter expert in any contractual dispute and advise on entitlements and establish agreement
* Support Claims negotiations with the detailed understanding of the contractual conditions and partner with regional claims to settle or escalate.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* The role needs to collaborate with the wider teams including Projects Control, Strategic Sourcing, DCD, Commissioning, Supplier Quality etc. for the successful execution of LLE/OFCI for the On\-Time delivery for a large, complex capital project
* Manages supplier activity and progress across multiple projects and complex purchasing categories, developing and executing supplier governance plan\-detailing mutual priorities and focus for the supplier relationship for the upcoming period.
* Educate internal and external stakeholders during kick off meeting/ onboarding and identify engagement programs to improve supplier performance to achieve business goals.


**Qualifications**
* Required Qualifications:
+ Bachelor's degree in engineering with min 10yrs of experience in Supply Chain, or related field, or equivalent practical experience in procurement, supply chain, project delivery, or related disciplines.
+ Strong commercial understanding of Product \& Capital Equipment procurement.
+ Extensive experience in Procurement, Project Management/Execution, Contracts management, Supplier management in a project environment is an essential requirement for this role.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hyperscale Data Center or Large building construction experience in an owner or general contractor capacity or in any large\-scale manufacturing organization
* Knowledge of data center industry and experience managing a variety of project delivery methods \- ability to lead a project team in defining risk and developing the appropriate contracting.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex and evolving environments while delivering results.
* Excellent communicator that can interact with diverse groups across organizational levels.
* Strong attention to detail, a continuous\-improvement mindset, and sound commercial and business acumen.
* Proven ability to implement new processes, build cross\-functional alignment, and secure stakeholder buy\-in for successful adoption.
* Must be able to drive \& execute supply chain execution strategy for multiple categories.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: AI Ops Application Operations Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
 The AI Ops Application Operations Lead owns the production lifecycle of agentic coding applications, plugins, and skills across Zeta. The role helps teams move high\-value prototypes into production and keeps applications reliable, useful, governed, and measurable after launch.
   

  

 This role partners closely with application owners, AI Operations, IT, Security, and other technical teams. Its primary focus is production readiness, lifecycle and release management, feedback loops, and clear visibility into adoption, performance, and business impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines application operations, technical program management, and product fluency. They do not need to be the primary developer for every application, but they must be comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools, understanding application architecture, translating business needs into technical requirements, and coordinating work across stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Readiness and Launch**
* Partner with owners of agenticly coded applications to assess whether an application is ready to move from prototype to production.
* Establish and manage a consistent production\-readiness process covering security, privacy, data access, architecture, user experience, support, monitoring, and documentation.
* Identify launch risks, dependencies, and gaps, and coordinate the work required to address them.
* Connect application owners with IT, Security, Data, Legal, and other teams involved in production approval and deployment.
* Develop launch plans, readiness checklists, support models, and ownership documentation for each application.
* Ensure applications have clear business objectives, target users, success measures, and accountable owners before launch.


**Application Operations and Lifecycle Management**
* Manage the ongoing operational health of production applications.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of fixes, enhancements, and technical improvements based on direction from the application owner.
* Coordinate application updates, testing, release management, and communication to users.
* Help ensure applications remain compatible with changes to models, APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, and security requirements.
* Establish clear escalation paths for defects, incidents, access issues, and performance concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation for application functionality, dependencies, ownership, and support procedures.


**Feedback, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement**
* Help application owners establish structured feedback loops with users.
* Collect and organize user feedback, feature requests, defects, and usage insights.
* Translate feedback into clear product requirements and backlog items.
* Support application owners in prioritizing improvements based on user value, business impact, risk, and effort.
* Coordinate user testing and validation before major releases.
* Identify common patterns across applications that could inform shared standards, reusable components, or broader AI Ops priorities.


**Measurement and Analytics**
* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide application owners with visibility into adoption, usage, reliability, performance, and business outcomes.
* Define appropriate metrics for each application, including active users, usage frequency, task completion, response quality, errors, latency, user satisfaction, and estimated time or cost savings.
* Monitor application health and surface risks, adoption gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with application owners to review performance regularly and agree on actions.
* Help determine whether applications should be expanded, redesigned, consolidated, or retired based on evidence.


**Governance, Standards, and Portfolio Management**
* Apply AI Ops standards for application development, production readiness, responsible AI, security, documentation, and measurement.
* Help create reusable templates, checklists, playbooks, and operating procedures for agentic coding applications.
* Support the development of a governed application portfolio and inventory.
* Ensure applications have clear ownership, approved data access, defined user groups, and appropriate controls.
* Promote consistency across applications while allowing teams to move quickly and iterate.


**Key Outcomes**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**
* Increased percentage of high\-value prototypes successfully moved into production.
* Reduced time from prototype completion to production launch.
* Stronger production readiness and fewer post\-launch issues.
* Clear ownership and support models for every production application.
* Consistent visibility into application adoption, reliability, and business impact.
* Faster response to user feedback and application issues.
* Increased adoption and sustained usage of production applications.
* A well\-managed portfolio of applications aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Experience in application operations, technical program management, product operations, product management, or a closely related role.
* Strong ability to coordinate work across business, product, engineering, IT, security, and data teams.
* Experience taking internal digital products, AI applications, or technology solutions from prototype through production launch.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical and operational requirements.
* Strong backlog management, prioritization, documentation, and release management skills.
* Experience defining product metrics and building or managing performance dashboards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving tools, standards, and priorities


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development, low\-code tools, or agentic coding platforms.
* Familiarity with modern AI models, APIs, agents, workflow automation, and application architectures.
* Experience working with enterprise security, privacy, identity, access management, and software governance processes.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, application monitoring, user telemetry, and experimentation.
* Experience supporting internal enterprise applications or employee productivity tools.
* Working knowledge of software development practices, including testing, deployment, version control, and incident management.


**Core Capabilities**
* Application operations and lifecycle management
* Technical program management
* Stakeholder coordination
* Production readiness
* Backlog and release management
* User feedback, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Application analytics and measurement
* Risk and dependency management
* Technical fluency
* Clear communication and documentation


**Role Profile**
 This role is well suited for someone who enjoys turning early\-stage prototypes into dependable, scalable applications. They are comfortable operating between business and technology teams, creating structure where processes are still developing, and helping application owners make decisions based on user feedback and performance data.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be practical, organized, technically curious, and focused on measurable outcomes. They will know when to move quickly, when to slow down to address risk, and how to keep application owners and technical teams aligned throughout the application lifecycle.

 Zeta Global is a data\-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

 To plan, source, negotiate, contract, procure and deliver materials, capital goods and various services to fill the requirements of the end users at ISB, Mohali, in prices that are competitive and cost effective

 The jobholder needs to schedule regular meetings for reviewing the tasks delivered and pending. S/he also needs to monitor customers’ feedback and enable resolution of the problems / issues. S/he needs to meet with the user departments to manage their expectations and review the performance of the Commercial team vis\-à\-vis the SLAs. The incumbent needs to identify reliable vendors who can meet the requirements of the institute and encourage new vendors who can offer more competitive prices and hence enable the cost advantage to the Institute. S/he needs to regularly evaluate the vendor performance and maintain an updated list of approved vendors for the institute. The incumbent needs to regularly interact with the vendors to address all the issues, give them feedback and seek their feedback.

 Technical Skills**

 Global Manufacturing Organisation (GMO)**

title: Director Portfolio Management
description:
**Reports to:** 
 the Global VP – Portfolio \& IP
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Genome Valley), India
 



**Entity:** 
 Meishi Pharma Services Pvt Ltd (India entity of Lotus Pharmaceuticals)
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 Drive revenue growth for Lotus Pharmaceuticals by identifying and bringing niche, complex, and differentiated products into the internal R\&D portfolio — products with high barriers to entry, limited competition, or technical complexity that create sustainable commercial advantage. Own the business case, secure CEO buy\-in through data\-driven recommendations, and govern the pipeline through stage\-gate review, in close alignment with the Global VP – Portfolio \& IP.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




***Niche \& Complex Product Identification***



* Scan global markets for niche, complex, or high\-barrier\-to\-entry product opportunities (e.g., complex generics, differentiated formulations, limited\-competition molecules) that offer strong revenue and margin potential
* Assess technical complexity, manufacturing feasibility, and competitive white space to prioritize products where Lotus can build differentiated advantage
* Build the commercial and technical business case — market size, competitive intensity, patent/exclusivity landscape, revenue/margin projection, and development risk



 Identify strategic API and formulation partners for products of strategic importance to the organization.
 ***Revenue\-Driven Decision Making***



* Present data\-backed product recommendations to the CEO, framed around revenue impact, time\-to\-market, and competitive positioning, to secure selection sign\-off
* Prioritize the portfolio mix to balance near\-term revenue products against longer\-term complex/niche bets
* Track realized vs. projected revenue impact of selected products post\-launch to sharpen future selection criteria



  





***IP \& Global Alignment***



* Ensure product selection avoids IP conflict and leverages exclusivity opportunities aligned with global strategy



  





***Stage\-Gate Portfolio Governance***



* Run the stage\-gate review process (concept → feasibility → development → filing → launch readiness) with go/no\-go/hold decisions at each milestone
* Track portfolio health — pipeline velocity, resource allocation, risk flags — reporting the Global VP – Portfolio \& IP



  





***Cross\-functional Coordination***



* Partner with R\&D, Regulatory,Commercial, and Finance to validate technical and commercial assumptions
* Manage trade\-off decisions when resource, timeline, or IP conflicts arise across the pipeline



  





**Requirements** 



* 15\+ years in pharma/life sciences, with strong experience in portfolio strategy, complex generics/product development, or business development
* Track record of identifying and commercializing niche or technically complex products
* Working knowledge of pharma IP landscape — patents, exclusivity, freedom\-to\-operate
* Strong business case development and C\-suite presentation skills
* Experience with stage\-gate or equivalent phase\-review frameworks
* Comfort operating in a matrixed global structure
* Advanced degree in pharma/life sciences; MBA a plus

title: Senior Manager- Settlements
description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 Arcesium is seeking a Senior Manager for our Trade Affirmations and Settlements group based in Hyderabad. The group is responsible for the timely and accurate affirmation, confirmation, and settlement of trades across asset classes on behalf of hedge fund clients, with a particular focus on OTC derivatives. The group works closely with counterparties, prime brokers, custodians, and internal middle\-office and collateral teams to ensure trade economics are verified, confirmations are matched within regulatory timeliness targets, and cash movements settle without disruption.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the work product of the team across trade affirmation, confirmation matching, and settlement processing for OTC derivatives and other asset classes, ensuring adherence to ISDA confirmation timelines and regulatory confirmation timeliness targets.
* Play an active oversight role in day\-to\-day operations, including escalation of aged affirmation/confirmation discrepancies and settlement breaks, business\-as\-usual troubleshooting, and setting direction and goals for individuals.
* Oversee verification and validation of paper and electronic trade confirmations, and the resolution of trade economics discrepancies with counterparties and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with investment managers, prime brokers, and administrators to resolve day\-to\-day exceptions, while driving more strategic initiatives to reduce recurring breaks and improve straight\-through processing rates.
* Liaise with other internal functions such as pricing, middle office, and collateral management to resolve discrepancies and respond to internal queries.
* Contribute to the specification and testing of system and process improvements, partnering with technology teams to support automation initiatives across affirmation and settlement workflows.
* Lead the onboarding of new client engagements onto affirmation and settlement workflows, driving process design, testing, and issue resolution through go\-live to ensure workflows stabilize quickly and operate reliably in steady state.
* Uphold and strengthen controls, procedures, and best practices across the affirmation and settlement function, including support during audits.
* Oversee global regulatory and market change management events impacting trade affirmations and settlements — such as settlement cycle compression (e.g., T\+1\), LIBOR transition, CSDR implementation etc. ensuring the team is prepared and operationally ready ahead of go\-live
* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers, building depth and capability across the affirmations and settlements function.


**What You'll Need**
* MBA (Finance) / CFA / CA or any other equivalent qualification.
* 9–12 years of work experience in trade affirmations, confirmations, and settlements, with strong exposure to OTC derivatives across asset classes.
* Complete understanding of ISDA trade confirmation processes, trade life cycle, and pre\- and post\-settlement processes for OTC derivatives.
* In\-depth domain/finance knowledge; attention to detail; ability to work with minimal supervision; and experience managing high performers.
* Drive to enhance the efficiency of processes and reduce operational risk.
* Strong project management skills and effective managerial ability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

description:

 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
   

  

 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
   

  

 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a
 **Data Center IT Infrastructure Manager** 
 , you will be responsible for the overall performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of data center IT operations within a dedicated region. You will provide strategic and operational leadership to multiple Data Center IT technicians, ensuring consistent service delivery, high availability of infrastructure, and alignment with business objectives.
   

  

 This role requires a strong leader with hands\-on experience in data center environments, capable of balancing day\-to\-day operational excellence with regional planning, standardization, and optimization of IT processes.
   

  

 You will act as the key escalation point for regional IT operations, driving best practices, operational maturity, and cross\-site collaboration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and manage Data Center IT technicians across the region.
* Establish clear goals, KPIs, and performance expectations aligned with global IT operations strategy.
* Ensure consistent implementation of operational standards, procedures, and best practices across all regional data centers.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical incidents and operational risks within the region.
* Oversee regional IT infrastructure operations, including servers, networking equipment, storage systems, and supporting hardware.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of mission\-critical systems, including GPU clusters and high\-density environments.
* Monitor operational health and capacity across sites, proactively addressing risks and bottlenecks.
* Review major incidents and root cause analyses, driving corrective and preventive actions.
* Govern regional change activities related to hardware installation, upgrades, decommissioning, and migrations.
* Promote automation, standardization, and documentation across data center IT operations.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, global IT teams, and external vendors or colocation partners.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and operational SLAs
* Provide regular reporting on regional performance, risks, capacity, and improvement initiatives to senior management.
* Ensure adherence to security, safety, and compliance requirements within data center environments.


 We Expect You to Have
   

  

* Experience managing multi\-site or regional data center operations.
* 8\+ years of experience in data center IT operations, including hands\-on infrastructure support.
* 5\+ years of proven people management experience, leading managers or large technical teams.
* Familiarity with high\-performance computing (HPC) or GPU\-based environments.
* Strong background in server hardware, enterprise networking equipment, and data center technologies.
* Solid understanding of data center operations, lifecycle management, and support models.
* Practical experience in project planning, execution, and cross\-site coordination.
* Knowledge of ITIL / ITSM practices and operational support processes.

* Excellent leadership, communication, and decision\-making skills.

title: Senior Manager, Production
description:
