 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Brief Description**
 This position carries key responsibility of ensuring site safety and meeting EHS targets, driving annual business plans to achieve AOP targets, and strategically managing the talent needs of the site. As a leader, this position is responsible for production, delivery with customer focus (ex. RK/PK), supply chain, quality, budgets pertaining to it, safety of associates and equipment’s, and talent management to ensure strong succession pipeline.
   

  

 This leadership position will drive overall operational performance, EHS and P\&L ownership for the plant, including hands\-on leadership of the Regal Rexnord Business System, which enables continuous improvement throughout the value stream. The right candidate will drive a culture of Continuous Improvement while achieving year over year performance improvement. The person in this role will actively lead Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost performance to exceed our stakeholders' expectations and enable growth in the business and play a key role in creating a vision as well as achieving short\- and long\-term strategic planning objectives.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Champions Regal Rexnord values and creates a culture of integrity, responsibility, diversity \& inclusion, customer success, innovation with purpose, continuous improvement, performance, and a passion to win, all with a sense of urgency.
* Consistently enhance EHS performance of site, fostering a safety\-focused culture and driving improved safety metrics.
* Set and monitor the performance of the plant to ensure that the plant is meeting its current and future production targets and quality standards.
* Monitor and drive continuous improvement related to speed, cost, quality, and safety metrics.
* Optimize the talent within the organizational structure and foster an environment to promote individual and team growth and career development goals.
* Establish strong relationships with associated business leaders and functional leadership i.e. Human Resources, Quality, Supply Chain, Technology, Sales etc. in order to ensure strong communication and alignment between manufacturing and its counterparts.
* Establish operating budgets; monitor and manage the cost and effectiveness of production activities to optimize resources, prioritize spending, and achieve volume, quality, and manufacturing standards.
* Implement and reinforce policies and procedures to ensure safety, quality, delivery and cost reduction goals are achieved.


**Drive Business Performance \- SQDCG (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Growth)**
* Effectively develop, communicate and align the organization around the business' Key Performance Indicators to ensure performance targets are achieved.
* Champion all EH\&S efforts. Ensure that associate and product safety are the top priority. Drive a culture of Safety and actively provide leadership relative to safety accountability with site leadership team.
* With the site leadership team, lead the business management cadence (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) that drives Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Growth performance throughout the organization.
* Responsible for both operational and financial performance of the business focused on Revenue, Operating Income and Cash performance. Effectively manage budgets and spending to achieve both long and short term business objectives.
* Partner with other Site Leaders, Business Unit, Business Segment and Central Functions to ensure both Regal's and Customer's Success.
* Work with business leader to establish annual operating budgets, including capital investment.
* Drive speed by removing waste and compressing lead times.
* Reduce year\-over\-year cost by a minimum of 3% net of inflation.
* Improve inventory turns through use of lean principles to deliver working capital metrics.
* Clearly communicate performance to key stake holders in the organization.
* Establish Continuous Improvement vision and drive reviews with high cadence to deliver.
* Be accessible, actively work with teams and support their journey during kaizen and GEMBA.
* Build a high performing team that is result oriented with high say\-do.
* Develop strong front line\-supervisory skills within the operations team.
* Recruit and retain top talent. Work with intentional strategies providing career and growth opportunities to team members.
* Foster a culture of appreciation and feedback in the plants.
* Maintain frequent communication with associates through the All Employee Meetings.


**Other Key Responsibilities**
* Actively leads and participates in the lean manufacturing initiatives by leading and owning key goals.
* Maintains up\-to\-date knowledge in respective industry. Keeps staff aware of new and significant developments and serves as a resource for all the staff, with emphasis on the strategic supply chain and manufacturing perspective.
* Keep track on productivity, efficiency, process improvements and monitors MIS and score cards accordingly.
* Implements actions to create a highly engaged, high performing, and inclusive work environment across plants.
* Ensure constructive engagement with union executive committee members and foster harmonious employee relations climate at shop\-floor. Ensure equal focus on shop\-floor discipline and employee engagement.
* Developing production employees managing healthy relations with production team and strategically leading wage negotiations with Unions.
* Provide hands\-on coaching to functional and site teams on manufacturing operations, lean concepts, Kaizens etc.
* Drives diversity and inclusion initiatives via innovative approaches.
* Acts as advisor and coach to the functional and site leadership on appropriate Manufacturing practices; ensures implementation and compliance.


**Required Education/Qualifications/Experience/Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical / electrical engineering or equivalent related experience
* Postgraduate in Operations management.
* 15\+ years of total work experience.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on production / manufacturing experience in consumer or industrial engineering setup with proven track record on EHS, Quality, production planning, materials management, Delivery, Productivity front.
* Exposure of working on multiple domains (Production, Quality Supply Chain etc.) will be preferred.
* Experience in in mid/large size Corporation (most preferred).


 Travel: Up to 25%
   

  

 Language: English \& Hindi (Plus)
   

  

**About Regal Rexnord**
 Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
   

  

 The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food \& beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
   

  

 Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation \& Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India\-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high\-performing, customer\-centric culture.
   

  

 The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success \& Operations (US\-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India\-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India\-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.
   

  

 As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success \& Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross\-functional teams located in both the United States and India.
   

  

 The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**People Leadership \& Team Management**
* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India\-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high\-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.


**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**
* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day\-to\-day execution, ensuring high\-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
* Provide local operational leadership, monitor performance and adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen team effectiveness, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure adherence to applicable USP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Controlled Documents, Operational Manuals, quality requirements such as audit readiness, and regulatory expectations.
* Monitor team performance against established service levels, quality standards, productivity goals, and customer experience objectives, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Utilize operational data, performance metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that support ongoing optimization of the Technical Services function.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on operational scalability, process harmonization, knowledge management, and service excellence.


**Scientific Inquiry Management \& Quality Oversight**
* Maintain a strong understanding of USP products, services, scientific resources, and customer support processes to effectively lead and support the team.
* Remain proficient in the functionality and use of Salesforce, including the Case Management Module and related service technologies.
* Conduct case quality reviews and quality assurance assessments for both US\- and India\-based Technical Services team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge assets, best practices, training materials, and quality improvement initiatives that enhance inquiry resolution effectiveness.
* Serve as a first point of escalation and directly manage customer inquiries as needed based on business demands, inquiry complexity, volume fluctuations, or resource requirements.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Strategic Support**
* Collaborate with Customer Success \& Operations, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Legal, Distribution, Global Science teams, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to support customer and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment between India\-based team members and global stakeholders, helping to ensure consistency in service delivery and execution.
* Contribute to the continued evolution of USP's global Technical Services operating model by identifying opportunities to enhance team capabilities, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and other duties as assigned, supporting the long\-term growth and maturity of the Technical Services function.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's degree in chemistry or relevant scientific field
* Minimum of ten (12\) years of experience in the pharmaceutical field, which includes hands\-on experience and expertise in chromatography, spectroscopy, and other analytical testing methods.
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience.
* Must demonstrate a strong customer\-centric mindset with a consistent focus on delivering high\-quality service, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction in a regulated or technical environment.
* Must have experience translating scientific or technical expertise into effective customer support, issue resolution, and service excellence outcomes within cross\-functional teams.
* Must be willing to work in 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST shift.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Willingness to travel to USP–Rockville for initial training purposes for approximately 2–4 weeks
* Knowledge of USP standards\-setting processes, compendial terminology, USP Documentary Standards, and USP reference materials
* Familiarity with laboratory workflows and ability to interpret customer issues related to reference materials and analytical testing to support effective resolution
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a high volume of work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a matrixed, global team environment
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and positive engagement in high\-pressure or time\-sensitive situations
* Willingness and ability to work flexible and/or extended hours when required to support global operations and customer needs
* Sufficient typing skills to support efficient case documentation and system usage
* Preferred but not required: experience using Salesforce CRM or similar case management systems


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Will lead a team of 5 scientists responsible for managing customer inquiries related to USP Documentary Standards and USP Physical Materials.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Chemistry \& Scientific Standards
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

title: Associate Manager - Data Quality & Governance
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking an Associate Manager Data Quality \& Governance Operations to join our Data Governance team, supporting our Data Analytics and Data Science organization in a hybrid work model. In this role, you will drive the delivery of data quality controls, data cataloguing, lineage management, and access governance capabilities on the Snowflake platform while collaborating with Data Governance, IT, Analytics, Data Science, and business partners. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast\-growing, science\-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Lead data quality workstreams within Snowflake, designing, implementing, and monitoring controls for assigned data domains while coordinating thresholds and remediation with data owners.
* Design and maintain auditable, version\-controlled data quality rules using Snowflake Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, and Row Access Policies aligned to business requirements.
* Monitor rule execution results, triage failures, and deliver exception reports and stakeholder dashboards that provide actionable insights to business teams, data stewards, and data owners.
* Maintain Data Quality Rule Registers and governance documentation that is current, audit\-ready, and aligned to enterprise data governance standards.
* Lead catalogue maintenance and metadata management for assigned Snowflake assets within Horizon, ensuring consistent, business\-meaningful documentation and inspection\-ready lineage records.
* Produce lineage and provenance outputs that help Analytics and Data Science teams understand metric derivation, trustworthiness, and data usage.
* Manage day\-to\-day access governance activities for Snowflake role\-based access control (RBAC) and attribute\-based access control (ABAC) structures, supporting certification reviews, audit evidence preparation, and governed Data Marketplace operations.
* You proactively identify risks, continuously improve governance processes, and build productive relationships across technical and business teams while supporting leadership and team development.


**This Role Requires**
* Bachelor’s degree and 7\+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree may be considered with 6\+ years of relevant experience.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, Row Access Policies, Tasks, Streams, and Snowpark.
* Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to write, review, and optimize data quality rules, logic, and data transformations.
* Experience designing and implementing data quality controls within a structured governance, compliance, or regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles, including data quality dimensions, data ownership models, metadata management, and governance frameworks.
* Experience maintaining data catalogues and business and technical metadata standards, including data lineage documentation and validation.
* Experience managing Snowflake access governance, including RBAC, ABAC, access certification activities, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Ability to manage defined workstreams and coordinate delivery across multiple collaborator groups with limited supervision.
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain data quality, governance, and lineage concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience in a regulated industry, preferably pharmaceutical, with familiarity with GxP data integrity requirements or equivalent frameworks.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core certification or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Horizon capabilities, including classification, governance policies, data sharing features, and metadata governance.
* Experience with Python or dbt for Snowflake\-based data quality automation.
* Exposure to Data Marketplace or data\-as\-a\-product operating models.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance tooling.
* Diligent and dependable, with a commitment to delivering accurate, well\-documented, audit\-ready governance outputs.
* Strong problem\-solving, risk identification, and continuous improvement attitude, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Governance, IT, Analytics, and business teams and support more junior colleagues.

This position will provide a central point of ownership and accountability for the overall ‘hands\-on’ management of the Mechanical, Electrical (M\&E) and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers in India. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on\-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Following are the primary responsibilities (but not limited to) of Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer:
   

  

**Operations And Maintenance**
* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post\-mortems, root cause analysis and follow\-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site\-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best\-in\-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
* Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
* Health \& Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
* Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
* Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.


**Incident And Emergency Response**
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
* Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
* Ensure 24\*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
   

  

* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
* Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained.
* Responsible for the on\-site management of contractors, sub\-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures \& local legislation.
* Perform and oversee maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
* Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12\-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on\-call rotations

* Influence senior stakeholders and drive execution across multiple functions.

 Desired Domain Expertise

title: Senior Trial Supplies Manager
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Senior Trial Supplies Manager**
 At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
   

  

 Global Clinical Supply Chain (CSC) is a new organization within Global Supply Chain (GSC). GSC’s vision is to be a patient\-centric, integrated supply chain, launching and supplying innovative products that deliver hope to patients through life\-changing medicines. The Global Clinical Supply Chain (CSC) organization contributes to this vision by working seamlessly across the enterprise to supply BMS’s global portfolio of clinical studies. CSC represents an innovative organizational model, an innovation that enables BMS for a future in which commercial supply chains will be increasingly similar to clinical supply chains due to advances in personalized medicine and targeted therapies.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Create and maintain supply strategies for all investigational product based on the scientific and regulatory confines of the drug’s development with minimal supervision. Working independently, they will be capable of mentoring others whilst acting as a consultant to others outside of the role.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Collaborates with internal Global Clinical Supply Chain (GCSC) teams and external Customers and Service Providers, including but not limited to Global Drug Development, Pharmaceutical Development, Product Development Quality (PDQ), External Vendors and Medical to ensure all needs are met.
* Proactively defines, plans, and communicates the clinical supply chain strategy in support of global clinical studies to ensure optimal use and alignment with study and corporate goals. Demonstrates robust knowledge and confidence of GCSC processes when presenting at cross\-functional meetings.
* Responsible for generating and driving strategies for continuous improvement, both departmental and/or inter\-departmental.
* Influences clinical and development timelines, study design and country selection. Directly responsible for reviewing and providing input to draft clinical protocols, communicating timelines and investigational product strategies to study and cross\-functional teams.
* Develops supply forecasts for complex studies through evaluation of the clinical development plan and protocol analysis. Monitors inventory and analyzes drug utilization versus forecast taking into account country requirements and logistical timelines.
* Issues Manufacturing and Packaging/Labeling requests to Clinical Supply Operations (CSO) in alignment with RDSC Master Planning timelines and based on collaboration with Clinical Development team, Chemistry, Manufacturing \& Controls (CMC) team and CSO Packaging and Labeling to ensure package design and clinical label for investigational product meet protocol and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor use date of investigational drug product for assigned protocols. Support use date extension activities, such as generation of Use Date Extension (UDE) memo, and provide feedback to Logistics team to support generation of UDE labels for depots and clinical sites.
* Ensures timely delivery of quality clinical supplies for all assigned compounds and protocols by collaborating with internal and external sources while taking into account country Regulatory and QP Release requirements.
* Participates in development, review and approval of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) specifications. Develops investigational product distribution strategies and maintains distribution and supply strategies at depot and site level according to study and IRT requirements.
* Actively participates in internal Trial Supply Management and Clinical Supply Chain meetings, Study Team meetings, Clinical Supply Matrix Team meetings and any other relevant meetings providing all relevant data and documentation prior to each meeting, highlighting any risks and mitigation strategies.
* Collaborates with Clinical Supply Strategic Sourcing team to procure commercial drug in alignment with country and clinical study requirements. Attends meetings with vendors and generates purchase requisitions as needed. Actively supports the budget process by maintaining supply and demand estimates for assigned studies in Budget Tool and by regularly reviewing and updating against revised clinical plans.
* Acts as the main Clinical Supplies contact person for the assigned compound and associated studies, leading communications regarding global supply strategy with study team as appropriate.
* Supports associated actions stemming from change controls.
* In collaboration with Compliance, prepare eTMF, CSR appendices and batch listings to support inspection readiness activities.
* Enters product complaints and deviations in appropriate system and works with PDQ for investigation and resolution.
* Manages conflicts/issues and leads issue resolution with internal and external partners and customers.
* Writing of departmental procedural documents as applicable.
* Performs other tasks as assigned.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Minimum 5\+ years Pharma industry related experience.
* Minimum 3 years Clinical Supplies/Development with global experience or equivalent experience.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute.
* Advanced knowledge of the global drug development process and global regulatory Requirements.
* Advanced analytical skills.
* Advanced communication and negotiation skills.
* Advanced project management skills.
* Advanced knowledge of forecasting and planning and proficient knowledge of related areas i.e., Manufacturing, Packaging \& Labeling, IVRS, Logistics, Quality, Stability, etc.
* Strong knowledge of import / export requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IVRS and CTMS systems.
* Advanced knowledge of industry technology and how to apply source innovative solutions and new industry best practices.
* Develops and applies unique ideas and new methods to achieve higher performance and excellence.
* Team and individual leadership (leads courageously).
* Oral and written communication (fosters open communication).
* Conflict resolution (manages disagreements).
* Negotiation (Manages Execution, Results Driven, Analysis of Issues, Effective Speaking, Builds Relationships).
* Influencing (manages influencing others).
* Delegating (provides direction).
* Coaching and mentoring (fosters teamwork).


 Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.
   

  

 Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives.
   

  

 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways\-of\-working.
   

  

**Supporting People With Disabilities**
 BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo\-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.
   

  

**Candidate Rights**
 BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.
   

  

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california\-residents/
   

  

**Data Protection**
 We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud\-protection.
   

  

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

Do not send application\-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.

title: Aftersales Manager
description:
Job Responsibilities – After\-Sales Manager
 



  




1. **Manage overall after\-sales activities** 
 , including service, spare parts, AMC, modification, and retrofit requirements.
2. **Maintain strong relationships with existing customers** 
 and ensure high customer satisfaction.
3. Handle and monitor
 **customer complaints and service requests** 
 , ensuring timely resolution.
4. Coordinate with the
 **Service, Sales, Engineering, Production, and SCM teams** 
 to resolve customer issues.
5. Review customer requirements and ensure the
 **correct machine parts, specifications, and part numbers** 
 are identified.
6. Prepare, review, and approve
 **quotations for spare parts, AMC, service, modification, and retrofit activities** 
 .
7. Ensure timely responses to
 **RFQs (Request for Quotations)** 
 and customer enquiries.
8. Develop and grow
 **after\-sales revenue** 
 through spare parts, AMC, service contracts, upgrades, modifications, and retrofit opportunities.
9. Follow up on submitted quotations and convert opportunities into
 **purchase orders and service orders** 
 .
10. Monitor
 **pending payments and outstanding receivables** 
 and coordinate with customers and the Finance team for timely collection.
11. Review customer
 **POs, payment terms, and order requirements** 
 before order processing.
12. Ensure timely processing and delivery of
 **spare parts and service materials** 
 as per customer requirements.
13. Plan and monitor
 **AMC renewals** 
 , preventive maintenance, breakdown services, and other service contracts.
14. Monitor the performance of the
 **after\-sales/service team** 
 and allocate customer requirements to the appropriate team members.
15. Track
 **service response time, complaint closure time, quotation conversion, sales, and customer satisfaction** 
 .
16. Identify opportunities for
 **repeat business, upgrades, machine modifications, and additional equipment/services** 
 from existing customers.
17. Maintain proper records of
 **customer enquiries, quotations, service reports, orders, complaints, and follow\-ups** 
 .
18. Conduct regular reviews of
 **after\-sales sales pipeline and pending activities** 
 and report the status to management.
19. Coordinate with customers regarding
 **service schedules, engineer visits, spare\-part requirements, and machine\-related issues** 
 .
20. Provide regular
 **MIS/management reports** 
 covering after\-sales sales, service activities, pending quotations, complaints, AMC status, and receivables.



  





 Key KPIs for an After\-Sales Manager:
 



  




* After\-sales revenue
* Spare parts sales
* AMC sales and renewals
* Quotation\-to\-order conversion
* RFQ response time
* Customer complaint closure time
* Service response time
* Outstanding payment collection
* Customer retention
* Repeat orders
* Customer satisfaction
* Service team performance

title: Senior Manager- Programmatic
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of the
 **Global Operations Centre (GOC)** 
 , you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Manager \- Programmatic who will:
   

  

* Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP GOC regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia)
* Lead the training and growth of your local programmatic team
* Enforce DV360 and TrueView best practices with a focus on platform expertise, consistency, and quality of work delivery
* Be accountable for consistent work delivery to WPP GOC regional teams by ensuring a high quality of output
* Serve as point of escalation for your team and take ownership of resolving challenges
* Provide career development and coaching for your team
* Line manages 2\-5 direct reports with as many as 10 indirect reports
* Provide timely and actionable feedback to the team to aid in their development, improvement, and progress. Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done
* Provide support to in capacity planning \& resource management for the team
* Present strong and effective communication across all levels


****Skills And Experience****
* 6\-8 year's professional experience with digital media preferably within a media agency/trading desk
* Experience in Google Marketing Platform (DV360, CM, GA360\).
* Experience in top AdTech \& MarTech platforms.
* Experience in Client Decks, Programmatic Strategy, New Pitches, etc.
* Hands on experience and knowledge on programmatic platforms.
* Clear thought process \& strategy to build on existing businesses.
* Competent in all Microsoft office software
* Working experience in Agency, Trading Desks or Programmatic Tech Partners
* Actual Campaign execution experience with most of the local programmatic players as well as measurement providers


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****

title: Delivery Manager - India
description:
Delivery Manager – India Business
 



**Location: Hyderabad, India** 




**Function:** 
 India Staffing Delivery
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ years in domestic staffing, including 3\+ years in a delivery leadership role
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 The Delivery Manager – India Business will lead end\-to\-end recruitment delivery for requirements generated by business development and existing client accounts. The role is accountable for building a high\-performing delivery team, translating client demand into practical hiring strategies, improving speed and quality of fulfilment, and delivering a consistently strong stakeholder experience. The successful candidate will combine hands\-on knowledge of the India staffing market with disciplined operational management, data\-led decision\-making, and strong client partnership skills.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Delivery leadership:** 
 Own recruitment delivery across assigned India business accounts and ensure fulfilment against agreed priorities, timelines, quality standards, and service levels.
* **Team management:** 
 Lead, coach, and develop recruiters and team leads; set clear goals, allocate workloads, review performance, and build succession capability.
* **Recruitment strategy:** 
 Convert client requirements and workforce plans into sourcing, screening, assessment, and closure strategies suited to the India talent market.
* **Client partnership:** 
 Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and hiring managers, clarify requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely delivery updates and market insights.
* **Pipeline governance:** 
 Review requisition health, ageing, funnel conversion, recruiter productivity, offer status, joining risk, and fulfilment forecasts through regular operating reviews.
* **Quality and compliance:** 
 Maintain consistent screening, documentation, candidate communication, data privacy, and statutory or client\-specific compliance standards throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* **Stakeholder collaboration:** 
 Partner with business development, account management, sourcing, operations, HR, and finance teams to align capacity, priorities, commercials, and delivery commitments.
* **Process improvement:** 
 Identify bottlenecks, standardize effective practices, improve turnaround time, and use automation and recruitment technology to strengthen efficiency and candidate experience.
* **Escalation management:** 
 Anticipate delivery risks, resolve account or candidate issues promptly, and implement corrective actions to protect client relationships and business outcomes.
* **Market intelligence:** 
 Track talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring, location dynamics, and emerging skill demand across India, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Resource and budget management:** 
 Plan team capacity, manage delivery resources responsibly, and support profitability through efficient deployment and vendor usage.



 Key Success Measures
 


* Requisition fulfilment and closure ratio
* Time to shortlist, time to offer, and time to join
* Submission\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-offer, and offer\-to\-join conversion
* Ageing control and hiring forecast accuracy
* Client satisfaction, service\-level adherence, and escalation closure
* Recruiter productivity, quality, retention, and capability development
* Candidate experience and compliance accuracy



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 


* 10\+ years of experience in the India domestic staffing industry, with at least 3 years in a Delivery Lead, Delivery Manager, or comparable people\-management role.
* Demonstrated success managing full\-cycle recruitment delivery for multiple clients, accounts, business units, or high\-volume hiring programs.
* Strong understanding of India hiring practices, talent markets, sourcing channels, compensation dynamics, and applicable recruitment compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to lead recruiter teams, manage performance, coach for capability, and create accountability for outcomes.
* Strong client\-facing communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and expectation\-setting skills.
* Hands\-on experience with applicant tracking systems, job portals, sourcing platforms, recruitment analytics, and productivity tools.
* Ability to interpret recruitment data, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical actions.
* Sound commercial awareness, operational judgment, problem\-solving ability, and a strong orientation toward targets and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or a related discipline.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience delivering IT, professional, or specialist staffing mandates in the Indian market.
* Exposure to managed services, recruitment process outsourcing, or large enterprise staffing programs.
* Experience managing distributed teams, multi\-location delivery, or rapid scale\-up assignments.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or certification in human resources, recruitment, or project management.



 Leadership Attributes
 


* Ownership and accountability
* Customer focus and business partnership
* Data\-driven execution
* Clear communication and decisive leadership
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced environment
* Commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

title: SAP Upgrade Planning-Deputy Director
description:

 The size and complexity of our SAP landscape with 20\+ SAP products \& 800\+ instances, combined with multiple deadlines for patching / versioning \& end of life and deep dependencies across strategic programs—make SAP Upgrades a mission‑critical function.
   

  

 Over the next 5\+ years, we will have to efficiently run all the large business critical upgrades with 100% efficiency \& no disruption to business – factoring in the deeply integrated global landscape.
   

  

 The upgrade planning manager is a strategic role which develops and maintains the PepsiCo SAP multi year upgrade strategy in collaboration with SAP and PepsiCo teams
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Primary
   

  

* 'Own the multi\-year SAP upgrade roadmap across all PepsiCo platforms, markets and regions
* Prioritize upgrade initiatives based on risk, business value, innovation, and SAP support deadlines
* Identify and resolve cross\-program dependencies and conflicts before execution begins
* Align with SAP/vendor roadmaps, licensing changes, and product lifecycle milestone
* Develop AOP plans including funding, resources, environments, and governance approvals
* Maintain and promote a single source of truth at the system ID level in the applications' inventory


 Shared
   

  

* Partner with Infrastructure and Cloud teams to align upgrade roadmaps with hosting capacity, environment strategy, and platform modernization plans
* Partner with Functional/DSO teams and Product Owners to prioritize upgrades based on business value, risk, and operational calendars
* Partner with Testing teams to estimate effort and reserve test windows, environments, and long\-range regression capacity for upcoming releases
* Partner with SAP/Vendors and Architecture teams to assess dependencies, product lifecycle changes, and required remediation actions\-
* Partner with Modernization team ensuring there is a wholistic view of the global SAP roadmap and north start which includes not only Upgrades but also modernization re\-platform applications


 Decision Rights
   

  

* Approve and maintain the multi\-year SAP upgrade roadmap, sequencing, and prioritization of initiatives
* Decide go/no\-go for entering execution based on readiness, dependencies, funding, and resource availability
* Decide whether upgrades priorities should be changed, accelerated or deferred based on risk and business priorities


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years in SAP programs, ERP transformations, or enterprise technology strategy\-Proven experience building multi\-year roadmaps for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, cloud, and adjacent platforms
* Strong knowledge of SAP product lifecycle, maintenance deadlines, licensing, and vendor governance
* Experience managing cross\-functional dependencies across infrastructure, security, data, testing, and business teams
* Executive presence with ability to influence senior leadership, secure funding, and drive prioritization decisions

title: Director, Technical Support Engineering
description:
**Description**
**Job Details**
 Salesforce.com is the global leader in customer relationship management (CRM) software. We pioneered the shift to cloud computing, and today we're delivering the next generation of social, mobile, cloud, and agentic AI technologies that help companies redefine the way they sell, service, market and innovate—and become customer companies. We are the fastest growing of the top 10 enterprise software companies, the World's Most Innovative Company according to Forbes, and one of Fortune's 100 Best Companies to Work For. * Own and drive Technical Support outcomes, efficiency and KPIs within region by Success Plan (Signature, Premier, Standard).
* Facilitate operational improvements which streamline processes, leverage automation and agentic AI, eliminate inefficiencies, and enable scale.

* Ensure agentic AI deployed in support workflows adheres to Salesforce's Trusted AI / Responsible AI standards, maintaining accountability for oversight of AI\-driven case actions and escalation outcomes.

* BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

* 5\+ years at the management level, leading managers in addition to individual contributors, to support large enterprise customers.

* Previous experience advising and increasing the benefits of collaborating with global teams.
* Practical experience handling multiple support teams, including outsourcers, with a good knowledge of all technical support functions and related engineering responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, metrics, processes, systems and tools for running a global Support organization.
* Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at executive level internally and with customers.
* Consistent track record leading sophisticated processes and driving continuous process improvement.
* Excellent project management skills, including demonstrated ability to run projects across teams where influencing skills are required.
* Ability to respond to high\-profile, high\-impact customer/product partner concerns in a way that drives customer happiness.


**Our Ideal Candidate**
* Consistent record of leading support teams and creating collaborative relationships with peers on the Support leadership team as well as Engineering, Product, Success, Services, Documentation, and Business Technology (BT).
* Acts as a work\-redesign orchestrator — continuously rethinking how support work gets done as AI capabilities evolve, rather than treating AI as a bolt\-on tool.
* Highly organized and an effective communicator and doer.
* Has a beginner's demeanor; always looking for new ways to make things better, challenges the status quo, and is willing to experiment with and learn alongside emerging AI agent capabilities.

title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - PEP
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Role \& Job Purpose**
**As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer\-centric approach. You will foster a high\-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.**
**The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual\-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.**
**Job Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership


**You will lead by example, driving a customer\-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high\-performance, results\-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high\-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change\-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing strategies) and driving collective actions.**
* People management Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check\-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.
* Operational management


**You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes. Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross\-team collaboration on joint initiatives. Provide guidance and support on complex, high\-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.**
* Performance management Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high\-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance. Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well\-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.
* Expertise sharing Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain\-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk\-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function
* Issue Management and Escalation


**Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high\-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.**
* Planning and execution Be accountable for driving your direct team's performance outcomes, ensuring key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met and enhanced. Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric\-related, to optimize output and results.
* Stakeholder management and communication


**Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross\-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.**
* Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.


**Qualifications**
**Requirements**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to produce clear, concise, accurate, and professional reports, summaries, and customer communications. Additional languages are a plus.
* At least 1\-2 years of leading small to medium sized teams, preferably in operations.
* Good understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding KYC/AML/Fraud/Risk and financial crime prevention.
* You are familiar with money laundering methods and other financial crime trends.
* You can build and maintain an environment where your team is incentivised to make decisions and apply a risk\-based approach to their work. This involves the ability to guide the team on the right course or course\-correct swiftly when necessary, ensuring resources and focus are directed towards the most impactful tasks.
* You are punctual, independent, proactive and willing to get things done.
* Strong operational management and tactical decision\-making skills.
* Can work with tight deadlines under pressure whilst maintaining high level of quality and competency.
* You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong organisational skills, great time management, and ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment.
* Ability to multi\-task and take responsibility in challenging situations.
* You are capable of identifying gaps in policies and processes and providing detailed feedback, including examples when possible, through the established communication channels.
* A strong process\-oriented and efficiency\-driven mindset.
* Proven track record of taking individual ownership and responsibilities as well as being a great team\-player. Ability to deliver constructive, well\-evidenced feedback that drives tangible behavioral change and performance improvement.
* Ability to analyze and move of team’s metrics


 Additional Information
   

  

**Nice To Have**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related field
* Certifications: ICA, CAMS, or equivalent certification (KYC/EDD/AML/Fraud/Screening/Risk focused)
* Ability to use analytics tools like, looker, superset, or other similar platforms.

title: Supply Chain Manager– After Market
description:
**Job Description**
 Role Summary
   

  

 The Supply Chain Manager – After Market will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end After Market supply chain process, including demand coordination, inventory planning, allocation, fulfillment, logistics follow\-up, warranty support, and service\-parts availability.
   

  

 This role will ensure that After Market and Warranty requirements are planned, executed, tracked, and escalated with clear ownership and measurable performance. The position will work closely with Service Sales, Asset Management, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, Sourcing, Quality, Product, Finance, and regional Supply Chain teams to improve service reliability, inventory control, and operational execution.
   

  

 The role requires strong operational discipline, hands\-on supply chain management, analytical capability, and the ability to convert business needs into clear actions, KPIs, and process improvements. While the position is primarily execution\-focused, it will also support the development of a more scalable After Market operating model as the business grows and new product lines are introduced.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 After Market Supply Chain Execution
   

  

* Manage the end\-to\-end After Market supply chain flow from demand intake through allocation, fulfillment, shipment tracking, and delivery confirmation.
* Ensure After Market and Warranty orders are monitored proactively and delivered in line with agreed service expectations.
* Maintain visibility of open demand, blocked orders, aging lines, inventory availability, supplier constraints, and logistics risks.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally to resolve execution issues across planning, warehouse operations, logistics, sourcing, and service teams.
* Escalate blockers early with clear facts, business impact, options, and recommended actions.


 Demand Planning and Inventory Control
   

  

* Support the After Market demand\-planning process using historical consumption, warranty demand, installed base information, customer/service inputs, and forecast assumptions.
* Maintain a rolling view of demand by key part families and critical service items.
* Separate confirmed demand from forecast or potential demand to avoid creating unnecessary inventory exposure.
* Review inventory health, including stock availability, inventory turns, coverage, slow\-moving items, excess stock, and obsolete\-risk items.
* Recommend actions to consume, rebalance, transfer, hold, replenish, or escalate inventory based on business need and service risk.
* Support inventory policy decisions such as make\-to\-stock vs make\-to\-order, safety stock, reorder logic, and preferred stocking locations.


 Fulfillment and Logistics Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely picking, packing, shipping, and delivery of After Market and Warranty orders.
* Track shipment status and ensure visibility of road freight, last\-mile delivery, freight\-forwarder updates, and delivery confirmation.
* Identify root causes of service delays, including allocation gaps, warehouse execution, transportation delays, customer readiness, supplier issues, or system constraints.
* Work with Logistics and Warehouse Operations to improve fulfillment lead time, shipment reliability, and cost visibility.


 KPI Management and Operating Rhythm
   

  

* Prepare and manage regular After Market performance reviews, including service performance, backlog, aging orders, inventory health, open risks, and action closure.
* Track key KPIs such as on\-time delivery, order aging, days to allocate, days to ship, days to deliver, backlog, inventory coverage, forecast accuracy, and root cause of service misses.
* Use reporting tools such as ERP, planning systems, Power BI, Excel, or equivalent dashboards to support decision\-making.
* Where system reporting is incomplete, maintain practical interim controls while supporting process and data improvements.


 Warranty, RMA/VRA and Reverse Logistics Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with the teams responsible for warranty returns, RMA, VRA, and reverse logistics to ensure visibility of open cases and inventory impact.
* Support clear handoffs between After Market planning, warehouse operations, logistics, finance, procurement, and service teams.
* Help reduce aging records and unresolved cases by ensuring actions, owners, and blockers are clearly tracked.
* Ensure reverse logistics decisions consider value, cost, service impact, inspection, repacking, refurbishment, scrap, vendor return, or storage requirements.


 Process Improvement and Business Growth Support
   

  

* Identify recurring process gaps and drive practical improvements in planning, fulfillment, logistics follow\-up, and inventory control.
* Support the standardization of After Market operating processes across regions.
* Contribute to the preparation of After Market supply chain readiness for new product lines and future service requirements.
* Promote a culture of accountability, service orientation, data\-driven decisions, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, Operations, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in supply chain, after market, service parts, logistics, inventory planning, warranty fulfillment, or operations.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end order fulfillment, inventory planning, allocation, logistics coordination, and cross\-functional issue resolution.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, demand planning, service levels, lead times, stock coverage, slow\-moving inventory, and replenishment logic.
* Experience with ERP, planning, warehouse, or reporting systems such as NetSuite, Anaplan, Power BI, Excel, WMS, or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, global environment with multiple priorities and time zones.
* Experience in renewable energy, industrial equipment, project\-based supply chain, warranty, or spare\-parts environments is preferred.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* End\-to\-end ownership and follow\-through.
* Strong operational discipline and urgency.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and structure open issues.
* Data\-driven decision\-making.
* Cross\-functional collaboration.
* Practical process\-improvement mindset.
* Clear and fact\-based escalation.
* Customer and service mindset balanced with cost and inventory discipline.
