title: Manager — Incentive Compensation Administration
description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration will lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of field incentive compensation plans and compensation cycles. The role will oversee end\-to\-end IC operations, including data and eligibility validation, crediting and calculation review, payment readiness, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation, while ensuring strong quality controls and adherence to approved plan rules and processes.
   

  

 The Manager will lead and develop a team of IC professionals, providing day\-to\-day direction, prioritizing work, reviewing deliverables, resolving complex operational issues, and driving accountability for quality and timelines. The role will serve as a key escalation point for IC administration issues and will identify opportunities to strengthen controls, simplify processes, improve data quality, and increase operational efficiency and scalability.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and partners closely with onshore business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, data management, analytics, technology, and other supporting functions. The role will also coordinate IC administration projects and key business events—including new plan implementation, annual planning cycles, field realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, and platform enhancements—while maintaining strong governance, documentation, audit readiness, and clear stakeholder communication.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IC Operations and Delivery Management**
* Manage the accurate and timely administration of assigned field incentive compensation (IC) plans and compensation cycles, in accordance with approved plan rules, established processes, and business timelines.
* Oversee day\-to\-day execution across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation.
* Review team deliverables and quality\-control results to ensure data accuracy, payment readiness, process adherence, and timely resolution of issues.
* Monitor payout trends, processing timelines, data\-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
* Support the operational implementation of new IC plans, realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, annual planning cycles, and system enhancements.


**Team Leadership and Development**
* Lead, coach, and mentor a team of IC professionals, including direct and/or indirect reports; provide guidance on priorities, technical questions, problem resolution, and quality expectations.
* Allocate work, track team capacity and deliverables, and ensure activities are completed within agreed timelines and service\-level expectations.
* Provide performance feedback and support team members’ development in IC processes, data analysis, platform usage, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and detail\-oriented working environment focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Act as an escalation point for complex data issues, calculation questions, field inquiries, and operational challenges.


**Governance, Documentation, and Process Improvement**
* Adherence to IC processes, internal controls, legal guidance, privacy requirements, applicable industry regulations, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Creation, maintenance, and periodic review of SOPs, QC checklists, business\-rule documents, process flows, exception logs, approvals, and records of critical discussions and decisions.
* Identify recurring process gaps, control risks, data\-quality concerns, and manual effort; lead practical improvements to enhance accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
* Support testing of IC platform enhancements, reports, automation opportunities, and process changes; ensure appropriate documentation and implementation readiness.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality, documentation quality, and data integrity across IC activities.


**Stakeholder and Project Coordination**
* Partner with onshore business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams, to clarify requirements, provide status updates, resolve issues, and align on timelines.
* Manage assigned IC administration projects and workstreams using Planner or other project\-management tools; track milestones, dependencies, risks, action items, and delivery status.
* Communicate operational updates, key issues, and plan\-administration insights clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.
* Support the Senior Manager or functional lead in preparing operational reports, project updates, and materials for key stakeholder discussions.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree and 5–8 years of experience in incentive compensation administration, sales operations, compensation operations, commercial operations, finance operations, analytics, or a related field.
* Experience leading projects, workstreams, or junior team members in a deadline\-driven operational environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant bio/pharmaceutical, healthcare, consulting, or commercial operations experience.
* Demonstrated experience in field IC administration, including plan implementation, eligibility, crediting, calculation validation, payment processing, reporting, reconciliations, and inquiry resolution.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, reviewing work, or managing direct and/or indirect reports.
* Strong ability to analyze complex data, investigate issues, monitor payout and operational trends, and make practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with industry\-leading incentive compensation administration platforms; experience with reporting, data, and automation tools is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, and accountability for team deliverables, issue resolution, risk escalation, and timely completion of commitments.
* Strong organizational, project\-management, problem\-solving, written, verbal, and stakeholder\-communication skills.
* Commitment to accurate execution, strong controls, confidentiality, and continuous process improvement.
* Willingness to be hands\-on on projects
* Good to have IC health checks, plan modeling and design, contest design, goal setting experience

description:

 Premio Living is a comprehensive home interiors and furnishings company dedicated to creating exceptional, personalized living spaces. Under one roof, Premio Living offers interiors, modular solutions, and furniture that combine design, functionality, and craftsmanship. From concept to completion, the focus is on refined, functional, and timeless spaces tailored to individual needs. The company operates with a unified vision and team, providing a complete living solution for customers seeking a one\-stop home transformation partner.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Head of Operations at Premio Living is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role oversees day\-to\-day operational activities, including planning, coordinating, and optimizing all interior projects from design through execution and service. The Head of Operations ensures efficient workflows across departments, supervises project timelines, manages vendor and supplier relationships, and monitors resource allocation. The role involves setting performance standards, implementing process improvements, tracking operational metrics, and ensuring adherence to quality, safety, and compliance requirements. The Head of Operations also collaborates closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to support business growth and deliver consistent, high\-quality customer experiences.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Execution**

description:
ABOUT US:
   

  

 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
   

  

 LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
   

  

 OUR PEOPLE:
   

  

 People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
   

  

 We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
   

  

 ROLE PROFILE:
   

  

 The Senior Manager \- Reliability Engineering is accountable for the reliability, resilience, and operational effectiveness of critical enterprise applications and platforms throughout the service lifecycle.
   

  

 The role will drive the evolution of the L2/SRE function from reactive production support towards proactive reliability engineering, using automation, observability, operational learning, and strong engineering partnerships to reduce toil, incidents, and operational risk.
   

  

 Working across engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and support, the role will promote shared ownership of production reliability and ensure services are continuously improved to meet agreed levels of availability, performance, resilience, and customer experience.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Lead the L2/SRE function and its continuous improvement, with accountability for improving service reliability, resilience, operational efficiency, and engineering maturity.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing L2/SRE team, fostering accountability, technical capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Define and mature Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to support clear, data\-led reliability and engineering decisions.
* Reduce operational toil through automation, improved tooling, self\-service capabilities, and simplification of repetitive support activities.
* Establish strong observability and alerting standards across logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and telemetry to improve detection, diagnosis, and recovery.
* Define operational readiness standards, ensuring services are supportable, resilient, appropriately monitored, well documented, and have clear recovery and escalation procedures before entering production.
* Lead effective Incident Management within L2/SRE, including response, escalation, post\-incident review, and identification of recurring issues. Partner with L3 on Problem Management and RCA, ensuring corrective actions and reliability improvements are tracked through to completion.
* Champion strong ITSM practices and operational hygiene across Incident, Problem, Change, service ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee proportionate, risk\-based Change Management and approval processes, ensuring changes are appropriately assessed, dependencies and conflicts are understood, implementation and rollback plans are robust, and higher\-risk activity receives the right level of scrutiny while avoiding unnecessary overhead for well\-understood, low\-risk change.
* Partner with L3 engineering and other technology teams to ensure production learnings, recurring incidents, support trends, and reliability concerns are reflected in engineering priorities and addressed at source.
* Drive resilience improvements through disaster recovery and failover testing, capacity planning, dependency analysis, and clear ownership of reliability\-related technical debt.
* Define, monitor, and report on service health and reliability measures, including availability, performance, SLO attainment, incident trends, recovery times, operational risk, and improvement outcomes.
* Apply strong technical judgement, risk assessment, prioritisation, and conflict\-resolution skills when making decisions in high\-pressure operational situations.


 What you'll get in return:
   

  

 At LSEG, we invest in excellence. You’ll be part of a high\-performing team where your expertise is valued and your impact is visible. We offer:
   

  

* Competitive compensation with performance\-based rewards.
* A flexible hybrid work model that supports work\-life balance.
* Access to cutting\-edge tools and infrastructure to do your best work.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, including certifications, conferences, and internal mobility.
* A collaborative culture that values technical mastery, ownership, and innovation.
* The chance to work on a globally critical system that powers secure financial transactions across markets.

title: ITSM Practice Lead
description:
**The Role:ITSM Practice Lead \- Configuration Management (CMDB)**
 We are seeking an expert ITSM Practice Lead and strategist to join our Service Management Office (SMO) team responsible for the Corporate Engineering Org's ITSM practices. As a critical step of our transition into an AI\-native enterprise, your mandate will be to evolve our Configuration Management and CMDB processes into a high\-integrity, and high velocity, framework of class\-leading service management practice.
   

  

 In this role, you will develop leading\-edge processes that establish a "single source of truth" for all service assets, leveraging your service management expertise to enhance data quality and drive automation that serves our AI transformation objective.
   

  

 Your core responsibility is to institute a robust service management framework of process standards that ensures the continuous accuracy of Configuration Items (CIs) and their intricate interdependencies, providing the essential structure needed to safeguard service stability. By establishing strategic guardrails, compliance frameworks (including SOX/SOC2\), and AI\-ready validation practices, you will empower our elite technical teams to maintain high\-fidelity data, eliminating friction across the ITSM landscape and ensuring high observability, through common practice, into complex service relationships.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Configuration Management Governance:** 
 Serve as the principal Practice Lead of Configuration Management Practices for the SMO, architecting and leading a professionalized governance function that defines the strategic practices of how the enterprise identifies and manages its technical estate. Define the process guardrails that ensure compliance standards and business velocity are both built into the fabric of the Configuration Management practice. Document and maintain the standards, guardrails and procedures, including a glide path, to ensure our IT Service Management processes follow a ‘well lit path’ for consistency, efficiency and service quality.
   

  

**CMDB Practice Design:** 
 As the primary design and governance lead of these practices, you will be accountable for designing the processes that enables the organization to consistently apply standards that, capable of overseeing complex service relationships across our ServiceNow platform.
   

  

**Cross\-Process Integration:** 
 Integrate Configuration Management practices with Incident, Problem, and Change Enablement to minimize risk and service degradation across the IT value stream.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Integration:** 
 Establish strategic partnerships with all stakeholders to ensure good CMDB practices are adopted to enable a unified source of truth for diverse enterprise needs.
   

  

**AI\-Native Data Strategy:** 
 Support the transition to an AI\-native enterprise by defining automated validation and reconciliation practices that leverage AI opportunities where possible, utilising existing tools and capabilities alongside ServiceNow to accelerate data maturity and eliminate manual processes
 **.**
**Practice Leadership:** 
 Serve as the strategic Practice Lead for Configuration Management (CMDB) within the SMO, contributing to the unified vision for the full suite of ITSM practices, and driving CMDB standards as an essential guardrail for AI Transformation.
   

  

**Outcome\-Based Governance:** 
 Manage effectiveness of CMDB practices through value\-based KPIs such as Data Accuracy and Reconciliation success, ensuring that our technology investments are directly contributing to business value streams.
   

  

**CMDB Stakeholder Alignment** 
 : Systematically identify and prioritize key SMO stakeholders to foster collaboration and secure buy\-in for Configuration Management standards across the enterprise.
   

  

**CMDB\-Enabled Service Vision:** 
 Lead the creation of a unified service vision by ensuring Configuration Management standards are integrated into, and act as a foundational element of, the overall SMO strategy.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for the broad ITSM practice standard, engaging cross functionally with key stakeholders across GTE and beyond. Own the resolution of process friction that prevents teams from adopting and applying the practices to their internal processes. Define the readiness criteria and governance for execution, in partnership with enablement and execution teams such as SPICE and SET.
   

  

**ServiceNow CoE Alignment:** 
 Ensure all Configuration Management and CMDB practices are aligned with the ServiceNow Center of Excellence (CoE) strategy, supporting the CoE mission to define and deliver services that strategically enable, scale, and govern Enterprise Service Management across Google. Partner with the CoE to integrate architectural standards and agentic strategies into the SMO framework.
   

  

**Community of Practice Development:** 
 Develop a “formal” Community of Practice across the stakeholder organizations to act as champions. Forge the collaboration to drive adoption and knowledge sharing, ensuring the standard is propagated organically rather than through enforcement.
   

  

**Platform Advocacy:** 
 Advocate for "Out of the Box" platform alignment within ServiceNow, favoring configuration over customization to enable AI\-native practices that facilitate high\-velocity automation.
   

  

**External Benchmarking and Best Practice Adoption:** 
 To continuously benchmark against industry leaders (outside of Google) and integrate external service delivery trends to ensure the practice remains leading\-edge and forward\-looking.
   

  

**Audit \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure the practices comply with all regulatory and compliance frameworks as necessary (e.g., SOX, GDPR, etc.) and that it provides technical integrity for audit audiences.
   

  

**Talent Development:** 
 Mentor the next generation of ITSM Practitioners, establishing clear principles for configuration management stewardship centered on quality, velocity, and AI\-enabled enterprise operations.
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of proven transformative leadership in large\-scale technology organizations, with the skill and profile to drive strategic, enterprise\-level Service Management transformation.
* 8\+ years of experience in ITSM leadership focused on implementing and governing ITSM Configuration and IT Asset Management practices in very large scale enterprises
* 5\+ years of experience with the ServiceNow platform,specifically Configuration Management (CMDB), Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and IT Asset Management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Exceptional Communication skills. The candidate must have the ability to comprehensively convey and implement a complex IT CMDB governance practice vision across a fast\-moving matrix organization
* Service Management Mastery: Expert\-level command of one or more ITSM frameworks, applied strategically to a modern business context.
* Advanced Certification: Likely holds ITIL Managing Professional (MP) or ITIL Strategic Leader (SL) certifications or a current equivalent.
* AI\-Native Vision \& Strategy: Experience architecting AI\-native service transformations that move beyond traditional models toward flexible, high\-velocity practices.
* ServiceNow Architect\-Level Insight: Deep familiarity with ServiceNow’s Configuration Management capabilities and processes, advocating for CMDB and CSDM alignment practices and standards that favors configuration over customization.
* Technical Fluency: Ability to translate ITSM practices into Agile, DevOps and SRE vernacular, ensuring the SMO is accessible, and clearly factors Engineering and Operational velocity into its practices.
* A proven ability to convert technical data into compelling, value\-driven business narratives for executive and audit audiences.
* Governance Sophistication: Proven capability to manage large\-scale service functions in a complex matrix organization while maintaining a strong focus on individual experience and business value.

title: Line Lead (Assembly Operations)
description:
**Line Lead (Assembly Operations)** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




**Experience:** 
 Minimum 4\+ Years in Manufacturing \& Assembly Operations
 



  





**About Solara Home** 




 At
 **Solara Home** 
 , we design and craft premium, modern kitchen appliances—including air fryers, high\-performance blenders, instant kettles, and different types of cooking utensils—that bring joy, speed, and health to everyday cooking. We pride ourselves on precision, sleek aesthetics, and uncompromising safety standards.
 



 We are seeking a high\-energy, detail\-oriented
 **Line Lead** 
 to manage and elevate our assembly operations. This role is pivotal in ensuring our kitchen appliances are built to perfection, on schedule, and in compliance with global quality and safety standards.
 



  





**Summary** 




 As the
 **Line Lead** 
 , you will oversee the daily operations of our kitchen appliance assembly line. You will lead a dedicated team of line operators, driving production targets, enforcing strict quality control (QC) and audit protocols, and implementing modern lean manufacturing methods. You will bridge line operations with quality management tools, shop\-floor manufacturing software, and hardware equipment to maintain an efficient, safe, and zero\-defect production environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Line Management \& Leadership** 



* **Operational Execution:** 
 Lead day\-to\-day assembly line workflows for kitchen appliances, ensuring daily throughput, Cycle Time, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) targets are met.
* **Team Guidance:** 
 Manage, train, and mentor a team of 10–25 line operators on standardized work instructions (SOPs), safety protocols, and proper tool handling.
* **Workstation Balancing:** 
 Line\-balance tasks to prevent bottlenecks, maintain uniform workload distribution, and ensure smooth continuous flow.



  





**Quality Control (QC) \& Audits** 



* **In\-Line Quality Verification:** 
 Enforce strict Quality Control checks across critical assembly stages (e.g., electrical safety tests, leak checks, motor fitment, heating element calibration, and cosmetic inspections).
* **Audit Execution:** 
 Conduct continuous process and product audits (5S audits, layered process audits, first\-piece inspections) to ensure adherence to Solara Home standards and safety requirements (UL/CE/ISO standards).
* **Defect Containment:** 
 Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using standard tools (5\-Whys, Fishbone / Ishikawa diagrams, 8D reports) when defects arise, taking immediate containment and corrective action.



  





**Manufacturing Software, Tools \& Equipment** 



* **Software Utilization:** 
 Leverage Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP \- e.g., SAP/Oracle), and Quality Management Systems (QMS) to log production data, track defect Pareto charts, and update inventory states.
* **Equipment Handling:** 
 Demonstrate working knowledge and oversee line maintenance for pneumatic/electric torque screwdrivers, automated testing jigs, hi\-pot/electrical continuity testers, ultrasonic welders, and conveyor speed controls.
* **Process Improvement:** 
 Apply Lean, 5S, and Kaizen methodologies to minimize scrap rate, reduce rework, and eliminate wasteful practices across the line.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum
 **4\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in a high\-volume manufacturing or assembly environment, preferably from an Operations and Quality Assurance Function (small home appliances, consumer electronics, or automotive assembly preferred).
* **Technical Quality Knowledge:** 
 Deep understanding of Quality Control methods, Statistical Process Control (SPC) concepts, Pokayoke (error\-proofing), and formal Audit processes.
* **Software \& Digital Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on familiarity with shop\-floor software systems (MES, QMS, ERP) and digital work instruction platforms.
* **Tool \& Equipment Expertise:** 
 Experienced with assembly line machinery, electric torque tools, electrical safety test equipment, and calibration gauges.
* **Problem\-Solving Skills:** 
 Demonstrated capability in running root\-cause problem solving and deploying preventive actions.
* **Leadership \& Communication:** 
 Strong interpersonal and team communication skills, with the capability to lead cross\-cultural line operators effectively under high production demand.
* **Education:** 
 Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, or equivalent trade certifications with relevant years of hands\-on experience.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean Manufacturing Certification.
* Prior experience with heating elements, small motors, or food\-contact grade materials and safety compliance.

title: Supervisor, SAM & CLH
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& CLH Analyst III is the shift lead and technical anchor for one of the three IST\-anchored shifts. The role carries two things at once: operational command of the shift — queue ownership, escalation resolution, and the handover into the next window — and the deepest technical expertise on the team, covering Corporate License Hosting server operations and the high\-risk legal and contractual gating that junior levels are not authorised to clear.
   

  

 On the CLH side the analyst monitors the health of the global floating\-licence servers, raises and validates licence file changes when contracts renew or quantities change, reads concurrent\-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor, and works daemon drops to resolution inside the 4\-hour SLA. On the governance side the analyst handles EULA and clickwrap reviews, checks the master review register before re\-reviewing, routes signed agreements out of the standard queue and into formal legal cases, and supports publisher relationships and business reviews. Three of these roles exist, one per shift, and each is the senior decision\-maker on duty when the manager is off the clock.
   

  

 CORE COMPETENCIES \& EXPERTISE
   

  

 To maintain operational excellence, analysts must demonstrate proficiency in the following key domains:
   

  

* Foundational Licensing Knowledge: Deep understanding of perpetual, subscription, SaaS, and true\-up models, including their unique compliance implications and operational requirements.
* Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Expertise: Advanced capability in managing floating\-license servers, editing configuration files, working daemon drops within SLAs, and analyzing concurrent usage metrics via the Altair Floating License Monitor.
* Governance \& Risk Management: Authority to manage high\-risk EULA/clickwrap reviews, check master review registers, and enforce the prohibition on signed agreements within standard queues by routing them to formal legal channels.
* Compliance \& Audit Proficiency: Mastery in constructing Initial and Final License Positions (ELP) by reconciling entitlement against usage evidence, and supporting publisher business reviews.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Shift Leadership \& Escalation Ownership
* Own the shift: allocate work across the Level III, II and Level I analysts on duty, hold turnaround targets, and act as the senior decision\-maker on the floor.
* Take and resolve escalations — customer complaints, blocked provisioning, entitlement disputes and licence failures — and judge correctly what must go to the ESAM Manager or the client rather than be absorbed.
* Run a clean handover into the next shift: open escalations, at\-risk items and in\-flight approvals documented and explicitly accepted, so nothing stalls in the gap.
* Mentor Level II analysts, review their complex casework, and build the bench for shift\-lead cover.
* Monitor the portal and ticket queues for the shift, keeping ticket hygiene and category coding correct so reporting downstream is trustworthy.
* Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Server Operations
* Monitor the health of the global licence servers hosting concurrent and floating licences, working daemon drops and service failures to resolution within the 4\-hour critical SLA.
* Raise and validate 'Licence File Change' requests on contract renewal, quantity change or expiry, editing the flat text configuration files on the hosting servers correctly and reversibly.
* Read concurrent checkout and peak\-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor — logging in strictly as a guest, and never entering corporate credentials without explicit system\-administrator approval.
* Assess new hosting requests against the CLH eligibility criteria: native floating/concurrent licence support, Windows or Linux server compatibility, a supported server daemon (FlexNet preferred, others subject to compatibility review), no geolocation or policy usage restrictions, and an active informative catalogue item for user instructions.
* Apply the CLH request\-routing matrix on unlisted floating\-licence requests — checking the hosted\-titles list, brokering spare capacity with the product champion and support owner on publicly shared pools, bypassing pool sharing on private pools, and capturing destination MAC addresses where a requester declines server hosting.
* Manage decommissioning: raise the support request to retire the daemon and remove licence files from the server when a hosted product is withdrawn.
* High\-Risk Legal, EULA \& Contract Gating
* Own high\-risk EULA and clickwrap review on the shift — copying non\-signed agreements to secure storage and checking the master reviews register to confirm whether an approved review already exists within the last three years before triggering a new one.
* Enforce the signed\-agreement prohibition: signed agreements are never accepted through the standard unlisted queue and must be routed via the contract intake path to be managed as formal legal cases.
* Identify and reject out\-of\-scope use cases on sight — code to be incorporated into customer\-facing products, personal devices, and reverse engineering — using the standard responses and correct onward routing.
* Coordinate vendor security assessments and legal\-review pipelines, and track the cases needing director\-level signature through to execution by the client's signatory. The team never signs.
* Support the renewal milestone schedule as the technical owner of licence position — building the Initial and Final Licence Positions from usage scans and consumption snapshots.
* Publisher Governance, Audits \& Continuous Improvement
* Support publisher relationships and coordinate Semi\-Annual Business Review inputs — performance data, utilisation evidence and action tracking — for the publishers in scope.
* Run the shift's weekly and monthly licence audits, and own the accuracy of savings and cost\-avoidance entries in the licence\-reclaim audit table.
* Identify automation candidates and author Business Requirements Documents where a publisher crosses 1,000 transactions a year, moving work onto robotic process automation or vendor APIs.
* Own the technical escalation path into publishers and resellers for entitlement, key and activation failures the shift cannot resolve.
* Maintain and improve SOPs for the technical procedures on the shift, so CLH work is repeatable rather than resident in one person's head.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* CLH Critical Response: resolve or contain critical Corporate License Hosting issues — daemon drops, server unavailability, checkout failures — within the 4\-hour SLA.
* Shift SLA Attainment: hold the shift's queues to the committed targets, with listed software inside 3 days and standard SaaS provisioning inside 1 day.
* Escalation Resolution: own every escalation raised on the shift to closure or explicit handover, with no silent ageing.
* Handover Completeness: 100% of shifts closed with a documented, accepted handover.
* Legal \& Authority Compliance: zero signed agreements processed through the unlisted queue; zero agreements signed by the team; 100% register check before a new legal review is raised.
* Licence Position Accuracy: Initial and Final Licence Positions delivered on the milestone dates and reconcilable to usage evidence.
* Audit \& Savings Integrity: weekly and monthly audits completed, with reclamation entries complete and accurate enough to stand as the savings record.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* CLH \& Licence Servers: global floating\-licence servers, FlexNet and other supported daemons, flat text licence configuration files, and the Altair Floating License Monitor.
* Entitlement \& Usage: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking, plus usage scans and SaaS consumption snapshots for licence\-position work.
* Contract \& Legal: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review pipelines, NDA requests and signature validation.
* Queue \& Automation: GUTS and Buganizer for ticket and bug management with strict category coding, and gHive / UiPath for automated reclamation.
* Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three\-way matching.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 6–10\+ years in software asset management or software licensing operations, including experience as a shift lead, team lead or senior technical escalation point.
* Hands\-on Corporate License Hosting or floating\-licence server experience: FlexNet or comparable daemons, editing licence configuration files, troubleshooting daemon and service drops, and reading concurrent\-usage metrics.
* Strong command of EULA and clickwrap review, licence terms and the commercial and legal risk they carry, with the judgment to stop a request rather than pass it through.
* Proven licence\-position work — reconciling entitlement against deployed and consumed usage and defending the result.
* Comfortable working a rotating or fixed non\-standard shift, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear English communication and the confidence to hold a technical or compliance line with client stakeholders and publishers.


**Preferred**
* Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential).
* Linux and Windows server administration exposure sufficient to work licence\-server issues with infrastructure teams.
* Scripting or automation literacy (Apps Script, Python, UiPath) for reclamation and reporting work.
* M\&A software integration exposure, including termination workflows under privacy constraints.
* Experience supporting publisher business reviews and audit responses.

title: WFM Operations Partner Lead
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We’re looking for a Workforce Management Operations Partner Lead to join our Operational team in our Hyderabad office!
   

  

 The WFM Operations Partner Lead is the primary interface between Workforce Management and Operations, responsible for ensuring that WFM disciplines are consistently understood, adopted, and applied in operational decision\-making.
   

  

 This role does not execute tactical WFM activities such as intraday moves, schedule creation, or capacity modelling. Instead, it acts as a business partner and discipline guardian, translating WFM insights into clear operational trade\-offs and constructively challenging decisions that undermine workforce plans.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Your mission is to shift Operations from reactive, short\-term workforce decisions toward planned, data\-driven execution, ensuring intraday, scheduling, and capacity principles are applied consistently to protect service, cost, and scalability outcomes.
* This role is not accountable for forecast accuracy, schedule creation, or intraday execution, which remain the responsibility of WFM execution teams.
* In addition, the WFM Operations Partner serves as a mentor and capability multiplier for Intraday and Scheduling Specialists, supporting their professional development and decision quality through guidance, coaching, and feedback, while maintaining a dotted\-line connection rather than direct people management accountability.


**Qualifications**
* 2–4 Years WFM/Ops Experience: Proven track record in high\-volume, scaled environments (Contact Centers or Shared Services).
* Financial Services Knowledge: Specific understanding of KYC, FinCrime, or regulated operational environments.
* The "Translator" Ability: Capable of turning complex WFM jargon (Erlang, Shrinkage, Occupancy) into clear, actionable business advice.
* Strategic Assertiveness: The backbone to constructively challenge senior leaders and say "no" when decisions undermine WFM plans
* Analytical Reasoning: Ability to interpret data trends and identify leading vs. lagging indicators rather than just reading metrics.
* Stakeholder Management: Experience acting as a partner rather than just a reporting function; comfortable operating with Heads of Departments.
* Forward\-Looking Mindset: A bias toward proactive risk identification and prevention rather than reactive firefighting.
* Change Management: Experience driving the adoption of new playbooks or frameworks across different operational units.
* Strong stakeholder management.
* Welcome challenges with a positive attitude.
* Easily adapt to changes.
* Extremely guided towards teamwork/collaboration.
* Flexible to work weekends/Public Holidays
* Schedule optimization experience / knowledge on how is it done


 Before applying, please ensure you meet the following requirements.
   

  

* You have been in your current role for at least 12 months at the time of application
* Your last GrowWise rating is "clear impact" and on track or above.
* You are not on an active disciplinary action and/or Performance Improvement Plan


*We highly recommend that you speak with your current Lead before applying. If you feel uncomfortable initiating this conversation with your Lead, please feel free to reach out to the Recruiter outlined in the job ad. They will be able to advise you on the next steps*
 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Manager, Local Lab Delivery
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Local Lab Delivery to lead the operational delivery, oversight, and continuous improvement of local laboratory reference range data management supporting our clinical development portfolio. In this role, you will oversee the end\-to\-end local laboratory data process, ensuring reference ranges, units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and associated metadata are accurately interpreted, quality controlled, maintained, and configured within laboratory management systems. You will also lead and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists and collaborate across Clinical Data Management, Clinical Operations, study teams, technology teams, and external partners.
   

  

**When \& Where**
**Hyderabad (hybrid)**
**Discover Your Role**
* Lead the operational delivery of local laboratory data activities across clinical studies, ensuring timely execution, quality oversight, issue resolution, and effective study support.
* Oversee the intake, interpretation, quality control, maintenance, and delivery of local laboratory reference ranges and metadata, including units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and study\-specific configurations.
* Ensure accurate and timely configuration, maintenance, and quality oversight of local laboratory information within the EDC Lab Administration system.
* Provide consultation and guidance on study\-specific local laboratory setup requirements, metadata, and complex local laboratory data issues.
* Oversee the maintenance, harmonization, and reuse of local laboratory metadata assets, including analyte libraries, laboratory templates, analyte mappings, units of measure, and reference range information.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex local laboratory data issues and lead root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation activities.
* Partner with Clinical Data Management, Clinical Operations, study teams, system owners, technology teams, laboratory vendors, and external partners to drive successful local laboratory delivery.
* Establish and monitor turnaround times, operational targets, and quality metrics supporting study startup, ongoing data management activities, and database lock achievements.
* Ensure local laboratory data processes, systems, and documentation comply with SOPs, work instructions, quality standards, GxP requirements, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement and technology enablement, including opportunities involving automation, AI\-enabled solutions, document extraction, unit harmonization, metadata classification, test synonym mapping, and quality review.
* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists while managing performance objectives, development plans, workload allocation, resource planning, and operational priorities.


**This Role Requires**
* Bachelors degree in Science, Health, Data Management, Mathematics, Computing, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of Clinical Data Management experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or healthcare environments.
* 5\+ years of direct Local Laboratory Delivery experience and 2\+ years of people management experience.
* Advanced knowledge of local laboratory reference range management, including analyte interpretation, unit conversions, conversion algorithms, test synonym mapping, reference range evaluation, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding of local laboratory data collection, validation, maintenance, quality control, and delivery processes supporting Clinical Data Management.
* Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, Clinical Data Management principles, EDC systems, laboratory administration systems, and related clinical data technologies.
* Experience managing complex laboratory data issues through root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation.
* Knowledge of applicable regulations, GxP requirements, clinical data quality principles, SOPs, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Demonstrated experience with operational metrics, targets, turnaround times, quality indicators, process improvement, and operational excellence.
* Strong leadership and people\-management capabilities, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, resource planning, and staff development.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Exposure to automation, AI\-enabled solutions, workflow optimization, metadata management, or digital transformation within laboratory data management is preferred.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* May require up to 25% travel

title: Shift Manager; Mars Petcare; Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Daily Operations \& FMOS Pillar**
* Shift Delivery: Lead the shift operations to execute the production plan on time and in full, optimizing line speed and aiming to maintain an Overall Equipment Effectiveness. Deliver all Safety, Quality and Cost parameters as per the plans.
* FMOS Governance: Serve as the primary floor leader for daily meetings (CP2 and CP3\). Own shift handovers, maintain physical/digital visual boards, and track hourly performance metrics.
* Deviation Management: Rapidly flag operational or performance deviations, implement immediate line adjustments, and escalate systemic technical blocks to the Maintenance Manager and Plant Manager.
* Daily Management System: Lead DMS for the plant.
* Zero\-Incident Culture: Drive a rigorous safety\-first environment on the floor. Personally execute Daily Safety Confirmations (DSC), lead Safety Conversation Walks (SCW), and enforce Stop\-Assess\-Control (SAC) protocols.
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain the packaging floor in a constant "audit\-ready" state for external and internal reviews (ISO, FSSC, QiD).


**Quality ( Quality pillar)**
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Ensure execution of quality control \& Standard Runing condition compliance by operators to deliver Finish Good products Right first time
* In case of deviation: pb solving/root cause analysis
* Apply Quality std in case of blocked products
* Hygiene measures to be implemented.


**Line Ownership \& Autonomous Maintenance (AM)**
* Equipment Ownership: Coach shift operators to treat the single packaging line as their own asset, fostering high levels of pride and care on the floor.
* CIL Standards \& Centerlines: Supervise and verify the execution of daily Clean\-Inspect\-Lubricate (CIL) schedules and strictly monitor equipment Centerlines.
* Abnormality Handling: Establish rapid Abnormality Handling (AH) routines to detect, tag, and resolve minor technical or material defects before they cause critical line breakdowns.


**Problem Solving \& Focused Improvement (FI)**
* Loss Analysis: Track and analyze packaging floor losses (unplanned downtime, minor stops, material scrap) to prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Operator Troubleshooting: Train and lead shift operators in using basic problem\-solving methodologies (5\-Whys, PDCA, Fishbone) to eliminate chronic line bottlenecks.
* CI Collaboration: Work closely with the Site Maintenance team to implement localized engineering, efficiency\-boosting, and 5S improvement projects.
* Waste control \& optimization Ensure the waste % are as per targets.


**People Management, Education \& Training (E\&T)**
* Shift Leadership: Directly lead, roster, and manage a team of 10\-12 operators and technicians, managing working hours, overtime, and absenteeism.
* Capability Development: Actively build operator capability using Step\-up\-Cards to develop a multi\-skilled shift workforce. Actively check individual performance to adapt training plan
* Knowledge Capture: Document and transfer on\-the\-floor technical skills through the creation and use of One\-Point Lessons (OPLs) and SOP
* Performance Culture: Conduct honest Performance Development Reviews (PDPs) and drive daily performance accountability using Individual Business Objective (IBO) cards.


**Job Specifications/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Production) or a related technical/supply chain field.
* 7 to 10 years of manufacturing experience (Food or Pharma)
* Minimum of 3 years of direct people management or shift leadership experience.
* Highly Preferred: Practical experience implementing or sustaining Lean, TPM, or TPM frameworks on the shopfloor.
* Preferred: Good working knowledge of food safety standards (ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP).
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English and local languages. Proficient in MS Excel and operational data entry.

title: Team Leader, ICE Climate Operations
description:
**Job Purpose**
 ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature\-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage\-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme\-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform.
   

  

 Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset\-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands\-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities.
   

  

 The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R\&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data\-related queries with increasing independence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Team leadership and delivery management
+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
+ Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change.
+ Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions.
+ Conduct regular one\-to\-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness.
+ Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts.

* Physical risk project and product support
+ Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high\-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage\-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private\-company asset classes.
+ Coordinate delivery with Product and R\&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development.
+ Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on\-demand QA or updates for client\-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme\-temperature exposure.
+ Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams.

* Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance
+ Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators.
+ Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third\-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources.
+ Review complex or high\-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
+ Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due\-diligence standards.
+ Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable.

* Data, reporting, and operational governance
+ Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance.
+ Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
+ Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand\-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve.
+ Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations.

* Process improvement, automation, and capability building
+ Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality.
+ Promote responsible use of AI\-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions.
+ Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms.
+ Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data\-intensive operational environment.
* Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset\-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research\-based verification.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and advanced Excel; practical experience querying and analyzing large datasets. Experience with BigQuery is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ability to resolve ambiguous or conflicting evidence.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Experience supporting Physical Risk, climate risk, catastrophe modelling, asset\-level analytics, or commercial geospatial data products.
* Exposure to facility materiality, industrial assets, mines, utilities, damage\-function or historical\-loss research, and third\-party location datasets.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools, workflow automation, and AI\-assisted research or validation processes.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit controls, client data samples, and cross\-functional product delivery.

title: Control Operations Lead Data Management Services
description:
**Job Title: Control Operations Lead Data Management Services**
 HSBC Data \& Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data\-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:
   

  

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data\-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well\-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.


 We are hiring a Control Operations Lead \- DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data \& Analytics Office)
   

  

 The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem that allows every business to implement them. Our vision is a self\-serve, automated route to meeting data control standards and delivering consistent, high\-quality data outcomes across HSBC.
   

  

 The Control Operations Lead – DMS, leads the team responsible for implementing and operating data controls across business areas, in line with standards and designs set by the Data Design team. The role ensures controls are executed consistently, outcomes are evidenced to the required standard, and control performance is continuously improved through disciplined operational management.
   

  

 The role owns the operational management of exceptions, ensuring issues are identified, triaged, investigated, resolved and closed in partnership with business and business\-aligned data teams.
   

  

 Success depends on building and sustaining strong, outcome\-focused partnerships with key stakeholders across CIO areas, CDAO teams, Businesses, CCO and Risk to enable control implementation at pace, manage interdependencies, and ensure consistent adoption of control standards.
   

  

**Governance and Committee Memberships**
* The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
* The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.
* The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply.


**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of data control implementation and day\-to\-day operation across business areas, ensuring adherence to agreed standards, timelines and outcomes. Translate control designs from the Data Design team into operational processes, procedures and run\-books that are executable, repeatable and auditable at scale.
* Drive consistent control execution across all operating locations, ensuring a single operating model with aligned quality standards, terminology, escalation routes and handovers. Ensure evidence and artefacts produced through control execution are complete, reproducible and meet requirements for Internal Audit, external audit and regulatory review.
* Own control performance management (MI, KPIs, control effectiveness measures), identifying themes, risks and opportunities, and driving continuous improvement. Establish and operate exception management (intake, triage, prioritisation, investigation, resolution and closure), ensuring clear ownership and timely remediation. Partner with Data Technology / Engineering and Product teams to shape tooling and workflow enhancements, using operational insight and effort data to prioritise improvements.
* Lead, develop and retain a high\-performing semi\-technical operations team; uplift capability across data governance, investigation, tooling fluency and operational discipline. Proactively identify and manage operational risk within the function, ensuring adherence to internal controls, policy requirements and timely closure of audit and regulatory findings.
* Lead a semi\-technical, multi\-geography team, ensuring consistent execution standards and shared ways of working across sites. Build a culture of ownership, operational excellence, transparency and learning; make it safe to surface issues early and solve them fast.
* Work collaboratively with CIO areas, CDAO teams, Businesses, CCO and Risk to deliver shared outcomes and maintain a strong control environment. Strengthen cross\-boundary teamwork with Data Design, Data Policy, Data Technology and Engineering, and broader transformation teams.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Strong knowledge of data governance and data management (data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, classification, privacy and retention) and their application in a regulated environment.
* Proven operations leadership capability: service management, run\-book discipline, capacity planning, quality assurance, and continuous improvement.
* Technical credibility to engage effectively with engineers and data platform teams; ability to interrogate data, understand datasets, and work with SQL / query\-based investigation (to an appropriate senior level).
* Strong audit and control mindset with experience preparing evidence and responding to audit / regulatory queries. Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including delivery through matrixed organisations where formal authority is limited.
* 15\+ years’ experience in data operations, data governance, controls, risk and/or technology operations within financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognised university. Demonstrated success leading large teams, including managing managers, across multiple locations.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional outcomes under challenging timelines while maintaining control quality and colleague wellbeing. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex operational issues clearly to senior stakeholders and committees.

title: Data Operations Lead
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The BP\&T HYD Data Operations Lead, Associate Director, provides strategic data leadership for the Hyderabad Data Operations organization and drives high\-quality execution, master data governance, NPI data readiness, and data quality across Global Supply Chain (GSC). The role leads and influences complex, cross\-functional initiatives that strengthen data as a strategic asset and enable process intelligence, digital transformation, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled supply chain capabilities. The Associate Director translates the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans, while also shaping priorities, risk decisions, standards, adoption measures, and value outcomes through regional, global, and cross\-functional forums. Working closely with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and BP\&T, the role builds a scalable data operating model across data foundation, mapping, stewardship, controls, lifecycle management, service performance, and continuous improvement. The role also develops data capability, coaches the Hyderabad team and matrix partners, and educates stakeholders on the business value of accurate, trusted, governed, and well\-managed data.
   

  

**Scope and Impact**
* Lead and influence cross\-functional data operations, governance, data quality, NPI readiness, and digital enablement initiatives with high organizational impact across GSC and the Hyderabad hub.
* Translate GSC, BP\&T, and Global Data Operations strategy into integrated roadmaps, execution priorities, decision points, KPIs, adoption measures, and measurable business outcomes.
* Provide strategic input to leadership and governance forums on data priorities, investment needs, operating model maturity, risks, trade\-offs, sequencing, and value realization.
* Strengthen decision making by connecting master data, process performance, data quality, operational controls, product lifecycle requirements, system impacts, and business outcomes.
* Operate as a regional data leader and matrix influencer, creating alignment across global, regional, and Hyderabad\-based teams on governance expectations, standards, accountabilities, and execution discipline.


**Duties/Responsibilities**
* Lead the Hyderabad Data Operations organization responsible for master data creation, extension, maintenance, remediation, obsoletion, and operational data services across GSC.
* Serve as the Hyderabad voice of data, representing data priorities, risks, opportunities, value outcomes, and improvement needs across regional, global, and cross\-functional forums.
* Shape and translate the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans with clear milestones, ownership, adoption measures, controls, KPIs, and value outcomes.
* Lead cross\-functional, complex initiatives across data quality, governance, data foundation, data mapping, lifecycle management, workflow optimization, automation, service maturity, and data operations scalability.
* Lead NPI and launch master data readiness by ensuring timely, accurate, governed, and risk\-managed data execution across planning, manufacturing, quality, serialization, distribution, and supply chain processes.
* Strengthen master data governance by embedding standards, business rules, stewardship responsibilities, controls, escalation routines, and data quality disciplines into operational delivery.
* Partner with Process Intelligence to connect process maps, data flows, process performance, data quality insights, operational pain points, and improvement opportunities into an integrated operating model.
* Use data quality measures, KPIs, service levels, stakeholder feedback, and issue trends to identify root causes, prioritize interventions, and drive measurable improvement in accuracy, timeliness, productivity, transparency, and stakeholder experience.
* Identify and influence opportunities for standardization, automation, workflow redesign, self\-service, digital enablement, and AI\-ready data foundations to reduce manual effort and improve scalability.
* Provide strategic input and recommendations to governance and leadership forums, including risks, mitigations, trade\-offs, dependencies, resource needs, adoption barriers, and decision options.
* Educate stakeholders on master data principles, governance expectations, stewardship models, data quality impacts, and the business value of trusted data in practical business language.
* Build strong partnerships with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and BP\&T to resolve complex data challenges and improve business outcomes.
* Develop data literacy and maturity across the Hyderabad and regional stakeholder community through forums, coaching, communications, training content, playbooks, and practical guidance.
* Develop and coach the Hyderabad Data Operations team and matrix partners by creating clarity on priorities, accountabilities, development opportunities, delivery expectations, and continuous improvement behaviors.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, quality, data integrity, audit readiness, and company requirements across data operations processes.
* Act as an SME and strategic advisor to projects and initiatives that create, change, rely on, or are impacted by GSC data capabilities, including reporting, analytics, process intelligence, digital transformation, and AI\-enabled use cases.


**Reporting Relationship**
* This position has a solid line reporting relationship to the Senior Director, Global Supply Chain Hyderabad Lead.
* This position has a dotted line reporting relationship to the Director, Global Data Operations, ensuring alignment to global data operations standards, priorities, and roadmap execution.
* This position has people management responsibility for the Hyderabad Data Operations team, while also leading through matrix influence across global, regional, and Hyderabad\-based stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Master, MBA, Engineering degree, or Bachelor degree with equivalent experience in supply chain, management, information systems, data management, engineering, life sciences, technology, or a related discipline.
* Advanced certification in Supply Chain Management strongly preferred, such as APICS CSCP / CPIM.
* Lean Six Sigma, data management, operational excellence, PMP, or equivalent certification preferred.
* 8\+ years of experience in supply chain, data operations, master data management, data governance, business transformation, or related business functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading and influencing operational teams and cross\-functional initiatives in a global, matrixed environment, including people development, coaching, capability building, performance management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Expertise across multiple supply chain data processes and capabilities, with strong understanding of end\-to\-end interdependencies, bottlenecks, risks, and business performance impacts.
* Strong understanding of supply chain master data structures, governance models, stewardship models, business rules, controls, data quality practices, and lifecycle management processes.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), launch readiness, product lifecycle management, or master data readiness for supply chain execution.
* Proven ability to develop and execute roadmaps, translate strategy into operational plans, influence governance decisions, manage priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders across Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and business transformation.
* Strong experience using KPIs, service levels, data quality metrics, risk management, and continuous improvement methods to improve operational execution and stakeholder experience.
* Exposure to ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP S/4HANA and associated planning, workflow, reporting, analytics, data governance, or data quality tools preferred.
* Executive communication, stakeholder engagement, influencing, education, and decision\-support skills, with the ability to explain complex data topics in practical business terms.
* Ability to build consensus, resolve conflict, manage risk, and align teams around standards, controls, governance, operating model maturity, and operational execution.
* Change leadership mindset with ability to lead through ambiguity, evolving priorities, digital transformation, and compliance expectations while maintaining operational discipline and data integrity.


**AD\-Level Competency Alignment**
* Leadership scope: leads and influences cross\-functional activities and complex projects with high organizational impact, requiring enterprise stakeholder management.
* Strategic contribution: reflects an AD\-level 40% strategy / 60% operations profile by shaping roadmap priorities, governance decisions, trade\-offs, and value realization while ensuring disciplined execution.
* Technical breadth: demonstrates expertise across multiple supply chain data processes and capabilities, with end\-to\-end understanding of dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks.
* Digital and data impact: leads implementation and adoption of digital, data quality, workflow, reporting, analytics, governance, and AI\-ready data capabilities with clear business value.
* Analytical leadership: leads risk management, mitigation planning, root cause analysis, escalation, and recurrent problem solving across multiple functional areas.
* Stakeholder influence: communicates effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels, influences requirements and decisions, and builds alignment across program, departmental, and functional forums.
* Leadership behaviors: coaches others, cultivates growth mindset, supports capability building, manages conflict proactively, and uses delegation and development opportunities to strengthen team and matrix partner capability.
